Monitor labour costs, overtime, transport spend, damages, claims, and consumables.
Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising service or compliance.
Support budget preparation, monthly forecasting, variance analysis and monthly flash.
Ensure operational activities contribute to margin protection and profitability.
People Management:
Lead, coach, and develop warehouse and distribution teams to achieve operational excellence.
Manage workforce planning, staffing levels, shift structures, attendance, discipline, and performance.
Conduct performance reviews and ensure training and development needs are addressed.
Drive a culture of accountability, teamwork, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
Manage employee relations matters in line with company policy and South African labour legislation.
Compliance, Risk, and Safety:
Ensure compliance with company policies, customer requirements, and all relevant South African legislation.
Maintain a safe working environment in line with the Occupational Health and Safety Act.
Ensure compliance with transport, dangerous goods (if applicable), food safety (if applicable), and security requirements.
Engage with internal SHERQ Team / Management
Lead incident investigations, risk assessments, and corrective action implementation.
Ensure adherence to quality, audit, and governance standards.
Systems, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement:
Use WMS, TMS, and reporting tools to monitor and improve operational performance.
Analyse operational data and generate daily, weekly, and monthly management reports.
Drive process improvements, standardisation, and productivity initiatives.
Support implementation of new systems, technologies, and process enhancements.
Develop and maintain SOPs, work instructions, and process controls.

The company’s clients:

About the position
Role purpose and context:
The Agile Coach Consultant partners with teams and leaders across the company to embed effective Agile, Kanban, and Flight Levels ways of working. The role coaches’ individuals, teams, and leadership on process, mindset, and tooling, using data and LLM-enabled insight to improve flow, delivery predictability, and time-to-value. Success is measured in outcomes: visual management lives across every squad, and a sustained reduction in average cycle time.
Engagement and location:
Contract engagement begins with 2 days for 6 months with monthly review checkpoints.
Remote, with working-hours overlap into the South Africa business day (and, where possible, US Eastern) for facilitated sessions.
Reports to Chief Technology Officer. Works alongside a separate DevOps consultant who owns the delivery dashboards and their data pipeline.
Key roles and responsibilities:
Coach teams, Scrum Masters, and Product Owners on Agile, Kanban, and Flight Levels practice to improve flow and delivery predictability.
Facilitate and continuously improve key ceremonies (planning, stand-ups, retrospectives) and team ways of working, primarily through facilitated group sessions supported by targeted 1:1s.
Diagnose organisational and team-level impediments and design pragmatic, metrics-driven improvement plans.
Set up and optimise the team workflow tool (ClickUp is the company standard) so every squad has visible boards, a clean workflow, and reliable flow data. Dashboard build and reporting infrastructure to the DevOps consultant. Familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, or Asana is useful for bringing in patterns from elsewhere.
Configure and optimise workflow tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, ClickUp, Asana) to support visibility, reporting, and flow metrics.
Build internal coaching capability by mentoring Scrum Masters and coaches.
Apply LLM/AI tooling to surface delivery insights and accelerate team improvement.
Must-have technical skills / experience:
Proven hands-on experience coaching multiple teams concurrently in an Agile/Kanban environment.
Solid grasp of flow-based methods (Kanban, Flight Levels) and Scrum framework fundamentals.
Experience defining and reporting on flow/delivery metrics (cycle time, throughput, WIP, predictability).
Confident working directly with engineering and product teams to embed sustainable practice change.
Minimum expertise required
Kanban coach (AKC) or Flight Levels coach (FLC)
Experience as a scrum master
Superb English written and verbal communication skills
Experience configuring a workflow tool (Jira, Azure DevOps, ClickUp, Asana)
Experience leveraging LLM technology to help teams improve
Seniority and experience:
Senior level individual contributor. Typically, 5+ years’ experience in Agile coaching, Scrum Mastery, or an equivalent role, including at least 2 years coaching multiple teams concurrently. Able to operate with credibility and influence at team and leadership level without formal authority.
Required qualifications:
Relevant Agile/Kanban coaching certification (e.g., AKC, FLC, ICP-ACC) or equivalent demonstrated experience.
Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM, or equivalent) advantageous.
Tertiary qualification in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Valid right to work in the applicable jurisdiction.

The role will work closely with Executive Management and will be responsible for ensuring compliance with South African labour legislation, company policies, governance requirements, and HR best practices.

Develop and implement the HR strategy, workforce planning, talent acquisition, succession planning, and talent development initiatives in alignment with business objectives.
Oversee the full recruitment and onboarding process, including recruitment governance, vetting, qualification verification, reference checks, workforce planning, and reporting on vacancies, time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, and attrition.

About the role:
Our client is looking for a Commercial Account Manager (CAM) to join their team in Cape Town. This is a client-facing role holding primary commercial accountability for a portfolio of clients - you will own renewals, protect and grow revenue, and ensure the company’s commercial position is managed cleanly across every account you own. You will work closely with their Technical Account Managers, Client Account Administrators, and Service Delivery Managers to ensure that the commercial relationship stays healthy alongside the technical one. This is not a technical role - it is a relationship, revenue, and process role that requires someone who can read a commercial position clearly, act on risk early, and lead a room with confidence at Quarterly Business Reviews.
The company’s clients:
The company’s clients for this role are high-profile hedge funds and financial services firms. These are demanding, high-expectations environments where commercial precision, responsiveness, and trust matter enormously. You will be representing the company to CFOs, COOs, and business stakeholders at some of the most prominent names in global finance. This means the CAM role carries real weight. Clients expect to deal with someone who understands the commercial and technical shape of their account, communicates with precision, and can be trusted to protect their interests and the company in the same conversation. If that kind of high-stakes client accountability energises you, this role will suit you well.
Reports to:
UK CEO
Client-facing?:
Yes - primary commercial contact for assigned client portfolio
Client base:
Hedge funds and financial services firms
Team:
Works closely with Technical Account Managers, Client Account Administrators, and Pod SDMs
What you will do:
Commercial relationship management:
Hold primary commercial accountability for a portfolio of assigned clients
Own the renewal process for each client; ensure contracts are current and commercial terms are correct
Own scope-creep conversations once flagged by the SDM or TAM, and translate operational signals into commercial action
Ensure client data in AutoTask is accurate at all times
Revenue and billing accuracy:
Check all invoices before client dispatch and follow up on billing queries
Perform monthly recurring service reconciliation (vendor to Autotask)
Conduct overall profitability analysis by product, solution, and support line
Sales and growth:
Identify upsell opportunities and loop in Technical Account Managers for technical context before progressing commercially
Complete PandaDoc proposals for all non-standard opportunities
Check proposal accuracy, manage client follow-up, and drive opportunities through to close
Quarterly business review ownership:
Hold overall responsibility for QBRs: ensure they are scheduled and happen on time
Lead and own the commercial slides; review the full deck before every client presentation
Ensure all parties - TAM, SDM, and the client - act on agreed follow-ups after every QBR
For micro clients (under 5 users), lead the service section of the QBR as well as the commercial section
What the role is not:
Our client wants to be clear about scope so that the right person applies:
Technical ownership: You
will surface commercial context, but technical service reviews and problem management sit with the TAM.
Queue management:
You will not manage the ticket queue or chase individual tickets - that sits with the Pod SDM.
Admin execution:
You direct and approve quotes, proposals, and reporting - the CAA prepares and executes them.
Incident command:
P1 incident command sits with the On-shift SDM. You are not involved in real-time technical incident response.
What the company is looking for:
Essential
Experience in a commercial account management, client relationships, or revenue-owning role
Strong commercial acumen: renewals, upsell, contract management, and profitability analysis
Solid conceptual understanding of networking, Microsoft 365, and Azure - enough to hold a credible technology conversation with senior IT stakeholders and follow a TAM's technical briefing without translation. You will not perform technical work yourself; it is handed off to the TAM and engineering team, but you need to speak the language
Comfortable managing billing accuracy, invoicing cycles, and reconciliation processes
Strong written and verbal communication skills - you can present commercial detail with confidence to senior stakeholders
Organised and structured: you can track multiple renewal cycles, proposals, and QBRs concurrently without anything slipping
Able to build genuine rapport with demanding, high-expectations clients while firmly protecting the company’s commercial position
Comfortable working UK -aligned hours (10:00 - 19:00 SAST) on a permanent basis
Advantageous:
Experience working with or within financial services firms - hedge funds, asset managers, or similar
Experience using a PSA tool such as Autotask, ConnectWise, or similar, and a proposal tool such as PandaDoc
Background in managed services, MSP, or IT service commercial management
Experience leading or owning formal QBRs or account reviews
Familiarity with subscription or managed-services pricing and licensing models

The CAM role sits at the intersection of commercial ownership and client relationship management. Your closest working relationships will be:
Technical Account Manager:
Your technical counterpart. They surface the technical signal and upsell opportunities; you own the commercial conversation that follows.
Client Account Administrator:
Your execution partner. They prepare quotes, proposals, invoicing, and QBR logistics; you direct and approve.
Pod SDM:
Source of scope-creep escalations. They flag; you own the resulting client conversation.
Leadership:
Profitability reporting, retention, and pipeline visibility

Promote a culture of clean, maintainable, performant, and scalable code.
Lead initiatives to improve development velocity through intelligent automation and tooling without compromising reliability.
Identify, source, and embed tools that improve Engineering quality and prevent production issues before they occur.
Ensure Engineering output improves in both speed and quality through automation, AI-assisted tooling, and Preventative Engineering practices.
Platform Security, Resilience & Availability -
Own the roadmap for addressing platform-wide technical debt, including vendor deprecations, mandated upgrades, and Cybersecurity vulnerabilities.
Collaborate with InfoSec and Infrastructure teams to ensure timely remediation of risks.
Plan and prioritize Engineering work that safeguards platform stability and compliance.
Automation & AI-Centred Engineering -
Identify and implement AI-assisted tooling for code generation, automated reviews, test generation, performance validation, and static analysis.
Embed AI code review capabilities where appropriate.
Introduce preventative automated tooling so quality issues are detected before reaching production.
Ensure responsible use of AI through governance, human oversight, and Engineering alignment.
Measure the impact of automation and AI adoption on quality, output, defect rates, and production stability.
Drive continuous improvement in Engineering practices through intelligent automation.
Strategic Collaboration & Partner Engagement -

Collaborate with the Platform Architect and Delivery Manager to ensure cohesive planning and execution.
Represent Engineering in strategic forums and contribute to platform vision evolution.

BSc Degree Level, or similar, in Mathematical, Computing or Engineering preferred.

Minimum of 5 years actively working with micro-service architectures in a Full Stack capacity, including Azure technologies, programming languages such as C#, and databases languages such as T-SQL.

Strong experience with UI frameworks, e.g. Angular, React, Vue.

Function Apps, Redis, Service Fabric, API Manager, Azure SQL, CosmosDB, Databricks, Event Grid, Data Factory.

Experience working with micro-service APIs, particularly in containerized implementations advantageous (e.g. Service Fabric).

Our client is looking for a Technical Delivery Manager to lead delivery across multiple agile software development squads, ensuring teams deliver valuable outcomes predictably, sustainably, and transparently.  This role sits at the centre of the software delivery lifecycle, partnering closely with Product Managers, Technical Leads, Engineers, QA, Designers, and business stakeholders. Build strong relationships with stakeholders across the organisation.
Manage competing expectations and communicate delivery impacts clearly.
Ensure dependencies and risks are identified early and actively managed.
Facilitate alignment and decision-making across complex initiatives involving multiple teams.
Continuous improvement and innovation
Drive continuous improvement of delivery practices, processes, and team effectiveness.
Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and evidence-based decision making.
Identify opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate waste, improve quality, and accelerate delivery.
Champion the adoption and effective use of AI and agentic tools to improve productivity, planning, communication, reporting, analysis, and team efficiency.

The Senior Business Analyst will act as a key liaison between business stakeholders, project teams, and technical resources to understand business needs, define clear requirements, analyse processes, and support the delivery of effective technology and business solutions. The role requires strong stakeholder management, analytical thinking, documentation discipline, and the ability to guide solution design from concept through to implementation.

Lead the design and implementation of advanced security controls across on-prem, cloud, and SaaS environments (Azure, Microsoft 365).

Analyse existing business processes, systems, data flows, and pain points to identify improvement opportunities and recommend practical business solutions.

Experience working with project delivery methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery models.
Strong understanding of systems analysis, process modelling, data flows, user stories, use cases, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

About the position
ENVIRONMENT:
Our client is currently seeking a Senior Power Platform Developer.  This role sits at the point where the Microsoft 365 estate, the Power Platform and conversational AI meet. You will design and build business applications on Power Apps and Power Automate, and you will design and ship the agents that sit on top of them in Copilot Studio. They are looking for someone who thinks in terms of enterprise architecture rather than individual applications. The work involves deciding where a process belongs, which parts of the Microsoft 365 and Azure stack should carry it, how data flows between them, and how the whole thing is governed once it is live. Building the solution is a large part of the job, but so is the reasoning that precedes it. Copilot Studio is a central skillset for this position, not a peripheral one. A meaningful share of their current pipeline work involves agents that act on enterprise data and trigger real business processes, and they need someone who has taken that kind of work into production rather than only through a proof of concept.
DUTIES:
Solution and enterprise architecture
Assess business processes and decide what belongs in the Power Platform, what belongs in Microsoft 365, what
belongs in Azure, and what should not be built at all.
Define environment strategy across development, test and production, including Dataverse provisioning, environment groups and managed environments.
Design the data model, starting with Dataverse tables, relationships, business rules and calculated columns, and
extending to integration with systems of record outside the platform.
Define the security model, covering Dataverse security roles, business units, teams, column level security and
hierarchy security and align it to Entra ID groups.
Set and enforce data loss prevention policies, connector governance and tenant level guardrails, typically through a Centre of Excellence pattern.
Advise clients on licensing and capacity, including the cost implications of Premium connectors, Dataverse storage, Copilot Studio messages and Power Platform requests.
Copilot Studio
Design, build and deploy custom agents in Copilot Studio for internal and client facing use cases.
Author topics and conversational flows and decide deliberately where to use authored topics and where to rely on generative orchestration.
Ground agents in enterprise knowledge, including SharePoint, Dataverse, public and internal websites, and file based sources, and tune retrieval quality rather than accepting the default behaviour.
Build actions that let agents do work rather than only answer questions, using connectors, Power Automate flows, agent flows, custom APIs and Model Context Protocol servers.
Implement authentication correctly, including Entra ID single sign on and user context propagation, so that an agent only ever returns what the requesting user is entitled to see.
Deploy agents across the right channels, most commonly Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Copilot, SharePoint and web.
Test, evaluate and improve agent behaviour over time, using analytics, conversation transcripts, escalation rates and topic level performance to drive changes.
Apply responsible AI practice, including scope limits, refusal behaviour, escalation to a human, and clear communication to users about what the agent can and cannot do.
Extend agents into Microsoft 365 Copilot where appropriate, including declarative agents and connected knowledge
Power Apps
Build canvas applications with well-structured Power Fx, reusable components and a considered approach to delegation and performance against large data sources.
Build model driven applications on Dataverse, including forms, views, business process flows and command bar customisation.
Develop custom components with the Power Apps Component Framework where the out of the box controls are not sufficient.
Design interfaces that people will actually use, including responsive layouts, accessibility and offline behaviour where the scenario calls for it.
Power Automate
Build cloud flows for approvals, integration, scheduled processing and event driven automation.
Build desktop flows for robotic process automation against systems that offer no API.
Develop custom connectors for internal and third party APIs.
Apply error handling, retry policy, concurrency control and monitoring, so that failures are visible and recoverable rather than silent.
Microsoft 365 and integration
Integrate solutions with SharePoint Online, Teams, Exchange and OneDrive.
Use Microsoft Graph where the platform connectors fall short.
Integrate with Azure services such as Azure Functions, API Management, Logic Apps, Service Bus and Azure OpenAI where a requirement exceeds what the platform provides natively.
Application lifecycle management
Manage solutions properly, including managed and unmanaged solution strategy, solution layering and environment variables.
Build deployment pipelines using Power Platform pipelines or Azure DevOps, with source control and automated deployment rather than manual export and import.
Maintain documentation that allows a client team to take ownership after handover.
Leadership
At Lead level, you will additionally own the technical direction of an engagement, review the work of other developers, set standards for the team, and act as the primary technical point of contact for the client.
REQUIREMENTS:
Core skills
Enterprise architecture
Microsoft 365
Microsoft Power Platform
Power Apps, both canvas and model driven
Power Automate, including cloud flows and desktop flows
Copilot Studio, including agent design, knowledge grounding, actions and deployment
Dataverse data modelling and security
Power Fx
Application lifecycle management and CI/CD for the Power Platform
Technologies
Microsoft Power Platform · Power Apps · Power Automate · Copilot Studio · Dataverse · Power Fx · Power Pages · Power BI ·Microsoft 365 · SharePoint Online · Microsoft Teams · Microsoft Graph · Entra ID · Azure Functions · Azure API Management · Azure DevOps · Git · MCP
Nice to have
Experience designing and delivering training, whether formal client enablement sessions, internal upskilling, or
structured handover to a client team at the end of an engagement. This carries real weight for us, because a large part of the value we leave behind is a client team that can operate and extend what they have built.
Relevant Microsoft certifications, for example the Power Platform Solution Architect, Power Platform Developer or Power Platform Functional Consultant tracks.
Experience establishing or running a Power Platform Centre of Excellence.
Experience with Power Pages for external facing portals.
Experience in a consulting or client facing delivery environment.
Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol and with agent patterns outside the Microsoft stack.
Traditional development background, for example C# or TypeScript, for the cases where the platform is not the right answer.
What they look for beyond the technology
The judgement to say when a low code solution is the wrong choice, and the ability to justify that position to a client who may have already decided otherwise.
Clear written communication. Much of the role is remote, and architectural decisions need to survive being read rather than explained in person.
A pragmatic view of AI. Agents are a strong fit for some problems and a poor fit for others, and they would rather hire someone who can tell the difference than someone who applies them everywhere.

About the position
We are seeking a highly experienced
Finance Transformation professional
to lead the design of a future-state Finance Data Model and Chart of Accounts as part of a major Finance Transformation programme.
The successful candidate will define the organisation’s future Chart of Accounts, reporting dimensions, financial hierarchies, master-data standards, governance frameworks and supporting finance data structures.
These structures must enable effective:
Statutory and regulatory reporting
Management and performance reporting
Planning, budgeting and forecasting
Group consolidation and reporting
Finance process standardisation
ERP and EPM implementation
Data governance and financial control
Future finance operating models
This role requires someone who combines deep finance and accounting expertise with proven finance-transformation delivery experience.
The successful candidate must be able to work across Finance, Tax, Actuarial, Technology, Data, Risk and business teams, translating complex requirements into scalable and implementable finance structures.
This is a high-impact position requiring both strategic leadership and hands-on design capability.
Key Responsibilities
Finance Data Model Design
Lead the design of the future-state Finance Data Model.
Define the Chart of Accounts, reporting dimensions, hierarchies and consolidation structures.
Design legal-entity, cost-centre, profit-centre, organisational and business-unit structures.
Define appropriate product, channel and management-reporting dimensions.
Establish finance master-data principles and standards.
Ensure the model supports statutory, regulatory, management and operational reporting.
Develop design principles that ensure consistency, scalability, governance and sustainability.
Ensure that the future-state design supports business growth, transformation and future technology initiatives.
Chart of Accounts Redesign
Lead the review and redesign of the organisation’s Chart of Accounts.
Assess the existing Chart of Accounts and identify opportunities to simplify and standardise its structure.
Ensure that the future design supports financial reporting, regulatory reporting, consolidation, performance management, planning and forecasting.
Define account structures, segments, hierarchies, attributes and roll-up rules.
Ensure the design supports data analytics and business-intelligence requirements.
Develop a mapping strategy from current-state accounts and structures to the future-state design.
Assess the impact of the proposed design on reporting, processes, systems, controls and users.
Finance Transformation and Operating Model Alignment
Align the Finance Data Model with the broader Finance Target Operating Model.
Support the design of future-state finance processes and organisational structures.
Ensure alignment across Record-to-Report, Group Reporting, Planning and Forecasting, Performance Management and Finance Data Governance.
Support the development of Shared Services, Centres of Excellence and finance ownership models.
Identify opportunities to simplify and standardise finance processes through improved data design.
Business Analysis and Requirements Management
Facilitate workshops with senior stakeholders to gather, analyse and validate requirements.
Lead requirements analysis across Finance, Tax, Actuarial, Technology, Data and business teams.
Translate reporting, accounting and operational requirements into practical finance-data structures.
Produce comprehensive business requirements and design specifications.
Develop data dictionaries, process maps, impact assessments and design-authority documentation.
Maintain traceability between business requirements, design decisions and implementation outcomes.
Document key decisions, assumptions, dependencies and unresolved matters.
Finance Data Governance
Design an appropriate Finance Data Governance framework.
Define data ownership, accountability and stewardship responsibilities.
Establish approval workflows and governance forums.
Define finance master-data maintenance procedures.
Develop data-quality standards and control frameworks.
Establish governance mechanisms for future changes to accounts, dimensions, hierarchies and master data.
Ensure that the future model can be governed and maintained after implementation.
Stakeholder Engagement and Facilitation
Partner with senior stakeholders across Finance, Tax, Actuarial, Technology, Risk, Compliance and Operations.
Facilitate design workshops, working sessions and decision-making forums.
Challenge existing structures and approaches where appropriate.
Guide stakeholders toward practical, scalable and best-practice solutions.
Present recommendations and design decisions to Executive Sponsors, Steering Committees and programme governance forums.
Build agreement across stakeholder groups with differing reporting and operational requirements.
Act as a trusted advisor on finance transformation, data design and reporting architecture.
Transformation Delivery Support
Support implementation planning and delivery activities.
Identify design risks, dependencies, impacts and implementation considerations.
Validate that proposed technology solutions support the approved finance design.
Define transition and implementation roadmaps.
Support the development of the finance data-migration strategy.
Establish requirements for migrating finance master data and historical reporting structures.
Support testing, training, change management and business-readiness activities.
Provide subject-matter expertise throughout the transformation lifecycle.
Ensure that all proposed designs are practical, controlled and implementable.
Key Deliverables
The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering:
A comprehensive future-state Finance Data Model blueprint
A detailed future-state Chart of Accounts
Reporting dimensions, attributes, hierarchies and roll-up structures
Finance data-design principles and standards
A Finance Data Governance and ownership framework
A finance master-data control and maintenance model
A current-to-future Chart of Accounts mapping strategy
Data-migration requirements and design principles
Reporting, process, system and control impact assessments
A stakeholder decision and design register
A future-state reporting architecture
An implementation and transition roadmap
Required Experience
Extensive experience in Finance Transformation, Finance Architecture, Finance Systems, Financial Reporting, Financial Control or a related discipline.
Proven experience leading enterprise Chart of Accounts redesign initiatives within large and complex organisations.
Strong experience designing finance data models that support multiple legal entities, business units, products and reporting requirements.
Experience defining reporting dimensions, hierarchies, attributes and roll-up structures.
Strong exposure to ERP, EPM, financial consolidation or enterprise-transformation programmes.
Experience aligning finance-data structures with Finance Target Operating Models and process-transformation initiatives.
Demonstrated experience developing current-to-future mapping and data-migration strategies.
Strong understanding of statutory, regulatory, management and group-reporting requirements.
Proven experience facilitating workshops with senior and executive stakeholders.
Experience driving complex design decisions across multiple stakeholder groups.
Demonstrated ability to translate business and reporting requirements into scalable design solutions.
Strong programme-delivery experience within complex transformation environments.
Experience producing detailed design documentation and implementation roadmaps.
Qualifications
Relevant degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce or a related field.
A recognised professional finance qualification such as
CA(SA), CIMA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent
is preferred.
Finance Transformation, ERP, EPM, data-management or process-related qualifications would be advantageous.
Technical Knowledge
The ideal candidate should demonstrate strong expertise across several of the following areas:
Chart of Accounts design
Finance data architecture
Finance master-data management
Financial accounting and control
Financial and management reporting
Statutory and regulatory reporting
Group consolidation
Finance Target Operating Models
Data governance and data quality
Planning, budgeting and forecasting
Performance management
Record-to-Report and financial close processes
ERP and EPM solution design
Reporting dimensions and hierarchies
Finance data migration
Business intelligence and enterprise reporting

Experience within one or more of the following sectors would be advantageous:
Insurance
Financial services

Other large or highly regulated industries

About the position
JDE Business Analyst
Own the heartbeat of the business · Manufacturing, Distribution, Assets & Finance
If you live in JD Edwards — not just around it — this is the role where your specs, your support and your improvements actually keep a complex operation moving. You are the trusted link between the plant, the warehouse, finance and the ERP. You write the functional and technical specifications. You keep the modules healthy. You turn messy change requests into controlled, documented delivery. And you put Insight BI and JDE reports in front of people who need answers, not more tickets.
This brief asks for real JDE tenure, real business analysis and real project lead time. If you have already done the hard yards across manufacturing, distribution, capital asset management and finance, you will be stretched — not babysat.
Why this role matters
·     You are the first call when manufacturing, distribution, assets or finance need JDE to behave.
·    Your specifications become the contract between the business and the system — clarity here prevents expensive rework.
·     You drive continuous improvement, not ticket-only firefighting.
·     You own change-control documentation so upgrades and enhancements stay auditable and safe.
·     You put Insight BI and JDE reporting in the hands of decision-makers.
What you will do
·     Write technical and JDE functional specifications for Manufacturing, Distribution, Capital Asset Management and Finance.
·     Provide holistic JDE support across all business areas — diagnose, resolve, escalate and close with discipline.
·     Partner with systems leadership on priorities, releases and module health.
·     Lead and coordinate projects: scope, timelines, stakeholders, testing and go-live readiness.
·     Manage the change-control pack — requests, impact, approvals, documentation and version history.
·     Deliver business intelligence through the Insight BI tool and native JDE reports.
·     Champion continuous improvement: simplify processes, reduce workarounds, retire tribal knowledge.
·     Work to site safety procedures.
What success looks like
·       Specifications are complete enough that developers and testers do not have to guess.
·       Business users get timely, accurate JDE support and trust the analyst behind the ticket.
·       Change is controlled — nothing material reaches production without a paper trail.
·       Insight BI and JDE reports are used, not ignored.
·       Leadership can see pipeline, risk and delivery without chasing you.
RequirementsWhat you must bring
·       Matric with Mathematics and Science.
·       BSc in Computer Science or BCom in Finance.
·       A qualification in Business Analysis, Service Delivery or JDE Application Support.
·       Minimum 5 years across JDE versions (EnterpriseOne / World welcome if module depth is real).
·       Minimum 5 years Business Analysis — requirements, process mapping, UAT, stakeholders.
·       Valid driver’s licence and reliable personal transport.
What will set you apart
·       Hands-on time in Manufacturing, Distribution, CAM and Finance — not a single-module specialist only.
·       Insight BI (or equivalent JDE reporting) you have built or supported, not only consumed.
·       Comfort writing both functional and technical specifications.
·       A bias for continuous improvement and clean documentation.
·       Calm under operational pressure — month-end, stock takes, asset counts, production exceptions.
Who this is for
·       This opportunity will suit a South African-based JDE analyst who wants to stay close to the business, not disappear into a generic ERP shared-service queue.
·       Ready to make JDE work harder for the business?
If the modules above are your daily language — and you can prove five years of JDE plus five years of experience — we want to hear from you

The Opportunity
A well-established financial institution is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Audit Manager to join its Internal Audit function in Durban. This is an opportunity to play an important role in strengthening governance, risk management, regulatory compliance and the internal control environment across the organisation.
The Internal Audit function provides independent assurance to Executive Management and the Board Audit Committee regarding the effectiveness of governance, risk management and internal controls.
Purpose of the Role
The Audit Manager will plan, lead and execute risk-based internal audits across the organisation. The position provides independent assurance on the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management, internal controls and regulatory compliance.
The successful candidate will supervise audit assignments, manage senior stakeholder relationships, develop audit team members and contribute to the ongoing improvement of the Internal Audit function.
Key Responsibilities
Audit Planning and Execution
• Lead and manage end-to-end internal audit engagements across multiple business areas.
• Develop risk-based audit programmes, scopes and testing strategies.
• Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of key controls.
• Use data analysis to identify emerging risks, trends and potential control weaknesses.
• Ensure audit assignments are completed within agreed timelines and budgets.
Audit Reporting
• Prepare clear, high-quality audit reports for Executive Management and the Board Audit Committee.
• Articulate audit findings, root causes, risk implications and practical recommendations.
• Present audit observations and conclusions to senior management.
• Maintain consistency and quality across audit documentation and working papers.
Stakeholder Management
• Build credible and constructive relationships with business and support functions.
• Participate in management discussions concerning governance, risk and control matters.
• Provide advisory support on control design and regulatory requirements when requested, while maintaining Internal Audit's independence and objectivity.
Audit Quality and Team Development
• Ensure compliance with the organisation's Internal Audit methodology and applicable Global Internal Audit Standards, including the IPPF.
• Maintain high standards of audit quality, evidence and documentation.
• Review audit working papers prepared by audit team members.
• Coach, mentor and support the professional development of auditors.
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the Internal Audit function.
Regulatory and Compliance Assurance
Assess compliance with relevant legislation, regulations and internal requirements, including:
• Banking regulations and regulatory guidance.
• South African Reserve Bank requirements.
• Prudential Authority requirements.
• The Financial Intelligence Centre Act and related obligations.
• Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing requirements.
• Internal policies, procedures and control standards.
• Monitor regulatory developments and assess their potential impact on the organisation and its control environment.
Follow-Up Reviews
• Monitor the implementation of agreed management actions.
• Conduct follow-up reviews to verify that findings have been appropriately remediated.
• Report overdue actions and significant control weaknesses to management and the Board Audit Committee.
Minimum Requirements
Qualifications
A bachelor's degree in one of the following or a closely related field:
• Internal Audit
• Accounting
• Finance
• Risk Management
• Commerce
Professional Certification
One or more of the following professional certifications would be advantageous:
• CIA - Certified Internal Auditor
• CA(SA) - Chartered Accountant South Africa
• CISA - Certified Information Systems Auditor
Experience
• A minimum of five years' Internal Audit experience.
• A minimum of three years' management or supervisory experience.
• Experience within banking, financial services, regulatory compliance or risk management environments.
• Strong working knowledge of AML/CFT, FICA and banking regulations.
• Proven experience engaging with Executive Management and Audit Committees.
Knowledge and Technical Skills
• Risk-based internal auditing
• Internal control frameworks
• Corporate governance
• AML/CFT and financial-crime controls
• Regulatory compliance
• Data analytics
• Audit report writing
• Root-cause analysis
• Process mapping
• Risk assessment methodologies
The Ideal Candidate
You are a commercially aware and principled audit professional who can balance independent challenge with constructive stakeholder engagement. You communicate complex risk and control matters clearly, maintain rigorous quality standards and enjoy developing others. You are equally comfortable working at a detailed technical level and presenting meaningful assurance to senior decision-makers.
Desired Skills:
Risk-based internal auditing
Internal control frameworks
AML/CFT and financial-crime controls
Risk assessment methodologies
Audit planning
Audit execution

Introduce new tenants to the portfolio through various methods including cold calling, advertising, social media, networking and nurturing long-term relationships with key broker contacts.

Understand competitor offerings and analyse market strengths and weaknesses in relation to the company’s offering.
Build and maintain relationships with key property professionals, including brokers, letting agents, valuers and potential tenants.
Provide complete, accurate and timely deal information to the office-based Leasing Administrator to enable preparation, collation and processing of required documentation for prospective tenants and lease agreements.
Follow up outstanding tenant information and documentation required to progress leasing transactions efficiently.

Analyse each shopping centre's tenant mix and recommend new tenants, concepts or categories that could improve the overall mix, trading performance and customer appeal.

Review prospective tenants' look-and-feel presentations, store design concepts and signage proposals to ensure alignment with centre positioning, tenant mix and landlord requirements.

About the position
ENVIRONMENT:
A dynamic and growing investment and commercial property management firm is seeking an experienced Property Portfolio Manager to serve as the commercial custodian of a diverse, multi-asset property portfolio located across the Greater Gauteng area. The successful candidate will assume full ownership of the portfolio’s financial performance, with a strong focus on maximising Net Operating Income, driving tenant retention across various asset classes, and ensuring strict operational and statutory compliance. This will be achieved by providing strategic direction to direct reports and effectively collaborating with shared support functions, including Facilities Management and Finance, to deliver an exceptional tenant environment and optimise investment returns for the business.
DUTIES:
Financial & Commercial Management (NOI Optimization)
Budgeting & Forecasting: Prepare, manage, and take ultimate accountability for the annual income and expenditure budgets across all assets in the portfolio.
NOI Growth: Identify and implement strategies to maximize Net Operating Income by driving rental growth, reducing vacancies, and strictly controlling operating expenses without compromising asset quality.
Arrears Management: Monitor arrears, enforce debtor control policies, and resolve outstanding tenant arrears swiftly to optimize cash flow.
Utility & Recovery Management: Oversee the accurate billing and recovery of municipal utilities, operating costs, and other tenant-recoverable expenses.
Reporting: Compile monthly management reports for the Regional Head, detailing financial performance, variance analysis, leasing activity, and risk mitigation strategies.
Tenant Retention & Relationship Management
Stakeholder Engagement: Act as the point of escalation and relationship manager for key tenants across the
Commercial, Retail, Industrial portfolio.
Retention Strategies: Proactively manage lease expires.  Initiate renewal negotiations well in advance (tailored to the specific asset class) to maximize the Weighted Average Lease Expiry (WALE) and minimize void periods.
Customer Experience: Champion a high-quality tenant experience, recognizing the distinct needs of each asset class (tenant experience vs footfall/turnover drivers in Retail).
Dispute Resolution: Handle and resolve complex tenant complaints and lease disputes efficiently and legally.
Leasing & Marketing
Vacancy Management: Drive the letting of vacant space. Appoint, brief, and manage external leasing brokers where necessary, while actively pursuing direct deals.
Lease Negotiation: Negotiate commercial terms (rentals, escalations, Tenant Installation allowances, beneficial
occupation) in line with approved mandates.
Market Intelligence: Continuously monitor the individual property markets / location trends to keep abreast of market rentals, competitor activity, and emerging trends in the commercial property market.
Operational & Facilities Oversight (Matrix Management)
Functional Direction: Provide strategic and functional oversight to the dedicated Facilities Manager, ensuring the physical assets are maintained to the highest standards.
SLA Management: Ensure that shared services (FM) and external contractors adhere to strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) regarding planned preventative maintenance (PPM), reactive maintenance, cleaning, and security.
Compliance & Risk: Ensure total adherence to Occupational Health & Safety (OHS) legislation, fire compliance, and municipal bylaws across all properties. Conduct regular site inspections alongside the Facilities Manager.
Capex Projects: Collaborate with the FM team to identify, budget for, and oversee capital expenditure (Capex) projects, upgrades, and tenant installations (TI).
Leadership & People Management
Direct Supervision: Lead, mentor, and manage the performance of the Property Administrator, ensuring high standards in lease administration, query resolution, and day-to-day tenant communication.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Foster a highly collaborative environment between Property Management, Facilities Management, and Finance to ensure a seamless, "one-team" approach to portfolio management.
Performance Reviews: Conduct regular KPIs assessments and development discussions with direct reports
REQUIREMENTS:
Education & Professional Memberships:
Bachelor’s Degree in Property Studies, Real Estate, Finance, or Business Management.
Experience
:
Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in a Commercial Property Portfolio Management or similar role.
Crucial: Proven experience managing a diverse, multi-sector portfolio.
Demonstrated experience holding bottom-line accountability for NOI and financial reporting.
Experience in matrix management (collaborating with and directing shared services/facilities teams).
Concluding lease renewals from start to end.
ATTRIBUTES:
Deep understanding of commercial property law, lease agreements, property management principles.
Eye for detail and constantly thinking about the tenant experience (customer satisfaction mindset).
Understanding of facilities management and management of same.
Strong financial acumen with the ability to interpret income statements, manage budgets, and calculate yields.
Excellent negotiation, communication and conflict-resolution skills.
High EQ with the ability to adapt communication styles across a diverse tenant base (from corporate CEOs to small business owners).
Proficiency in MDA, MRI, Excel, Outlook, SharePoint, Microsoft CoPilot

Role Summary
Senior delivery role requiring strong technical fluency, stakeholder integration capability and disciplined execution through the build phase. Although titled as an Engineering Lead, the role carries broader responsibility for coordinating delivery readiness across business, product, architecture and build stakeholders. Leads the build phase of technology initiatives by aligning business, product, architecture and engineering stakeholders, ensuring technical specifications are delivery-ready, and driving the build team to execute against agreed scope, quality and timelines.
Responsibilities
Drive end-to-end technical delivery through the build phase, ensuring work is sequenced, controlled and aligned to agreed priorities, scope and delivery milestones.
Coordinate Business Product Owners, Technical Product Owners, the Chief Architect and engineering teams to maintain delivery clarity, decision-making and momentum.
Oversee the development, review and readiness of technical specification documents and supporting build artefacts before engineering execution starts.
Manage delivery risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies and decisions across multiple workstreams and stakeholder groups.
Provide governance, status reporting and escalation management to support quality delivery, issue resolution and timely decision-making.

Translate business and product intent into a coordinated technical execution plan for the build team.
Ensure technical requirements, specifications, dependencies, interfaces and acceptance criteria are sufficiently defined before build starts.
Direct and coordinate build activities across development and supporting teams to deliver against scope, timeline and quality expectations.
Facilitate alignment between architecture decisions, technical design, backlog priorities and engineering execution.
Track progress against milestones and intervene where blockers, design gaps, resourcing issues or delivery risks arise.
Support readiness for testing, release and implementation by ensuring build outputs are complete, controlled and traceable.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related field preferred
At least 10+ years of experience working in software development teams
Formal training or certification in software engineering practices, architecture, or cloud technologies
Agile delivery certification (e.g. Scrum, or equivalent) – practical application preferred over theory
Strong grounding in secure software development practices and non-functional requirements
Proven track record leading large, multi-disciplinary engineering teams across complex enterprise programmes
Experience delivering mission-critical platforms in regulated environments (e.g. banking, financial services, or large enterprises)
Strong background in modern application architectures, including:
Cloud-native and distributed systems
API-first and microservices architectures
Event-driven and integration-heavy platforms
Demonstrated leadership across the full software development lifecycle, from design and build through to release, hypercare, and stabilisation
Experience working within Agile / SAFe / hybrid delivery models, aligned to strong governance and reporting expectations
Proven ability to manage and balance technical quality, delivery pace, and operational stability
Experience collaborating closely with:
Product Owners and Business stakeholders
Architecture, Security, and Platform teams
UX / Experience Design and QA functions
Strong exposure to DevSecOps, CI/CD pipelines, and production release governance
Experience operating in multi-vendor or partner environments, with accountability for engineering outcomes.

About the position
As a Financial Accountant at the company, you will strengthen the company’s Finance & Legal operating capacity by providing a capable, technically grounded set of hands across audit support, tax support, statutory support, day-to-day finance execution and practical AI-enabled process improvement.
This is a hands-on generalist role for someone who is early in their career but already has strong accounting and finance foundations. You will help the company run a more controlled, compliant and scalable finance function across multiple African markets. You’ll work across legal entities, countries, advisers and internal teams to keep audits, filings, documentation, payment workflows and recurring finance processes moving.  The company is also looking for someone who is comfortable using AI tools to make finance work more scalable — either through existing practical proficiency in building tools, automation and better operating systems, or through a strong curiosity and enthusiasm to learn this deeply.
You will:
Support audits, tax and statutory work
: Help coordinate audit requests, tax submissions, statutory filings, governance records and supporting documentation across the companies group entities. You’ll make sure requests are logged, owners are clear, evidence is gathered, advisers are followed up and deadlines are visible.
Bring structure to messy finance workstreams
: Build and maintain practical trackers, calendars, checklists and document repositories for recurring Finance & Legal obligations. You’ll help turn scattered email threads, adviser comments and internal discussions into clear action plans.
Improve finance operations
: Support day-to-day finance workflows including payment processes, approval flows, reconciliation support, documentation packs, month-end support and recurring reporting tasks. You’ll be expected to spot opportunities to make these processes cleaner and more repeatable.
Use AI to build scalable systems
: Apply AI tools and automation thoughtfully within the Finance function — for example to summarise messy information, improve trackers, draft and maintain reusable documentation, build checklists, automate repeatable workflows, create better templates, and reduce manual rework.
Coordinate across countries and advisers:
Work with Finance team members, country owners, auditors, tax advisers, legal advisers, accountants and payment providers. You’ll need to follow up persistently, ask clear questions, and escalate blockers early.
Support cross-border finance topics
: Assist with practical work around intercompany balances, entity funding flows, FX exposure, upstreaming constraints, management recharges and related-party documentation, while escalating specialist judgement calls to senior finance leaders or external advisers.
Own commercial outcomes
: Being in Finance at company is not about sitting behind a spreadsheet. You’ll be expected to understand how finance, tax, governance and compliance work affects the real business, and to help make practical things happen.
Ideal background:
Education
: Accounting, finance, business, economics or related degree.
Professional background
: CA(SA), ACCA, CIMA, CPA, articles, audit background or equivalent professional training is strongly preferred. A recently qualified CA, CIMA or similar profile would be a strong fit.
Experience:
0-2 years of relevant post-training experience in audit, financial reporting, tax, governance, regulatory, financial services, fintech, lending, emerging markets or a multi-entity group environment. Financial Services background or experience is preferable.
Technical Skills:
Strong accounting and finance foundations; comfort with audit requests, reconciliations, filings, entity records, controls, financial documentation and spreadsheets. Familiarity with VAT, withholding tax, income tax, transfer pricing, statutory compliance or cross-border finance topics is advantageous.
AI and systems capability
: Practical comfort with AI tools, automation and modern productivity systems. Ideally, you have used AI personally or professionally to build useful tools, structure documentation, summarise information, analyse data, improve trackers, automate repeatable workflows or create more scalable operating systems. If you are not already highly proficient, you should be genuinely enthusiastic about becoming highly capable in this area and applying it to real Finance problems.
Execution Skills
: Highly organised and reliable, with the ability to manage many small moving pieces, define owners, set deadlines, track progress and escalate blockers.
Communication:
Clear and concise written communicator who can translate messy finance, adviser and internal inputs into structured summaries, trackers and action plans.
Mindset:
High ownership, strong bias to action, willingness to do unglamorous but important work, curiosity about how the business works, and motivation to build better finance infrastructure for a growing African asset-financing business. You should be excited by the opportunity to use technology and AI to build scalable, enduring Finance systems rather than simply repeating manual tasks.

Accounting
Systems thinking
AI leveraging
Organisation
Analysis
Ownership

About the position
Our client, a global pharmaceutical company is looking for a Responsible Pharmacist - Supply Operations Quality Manager to join their team.  This position is based in Midrand.
The primary purpose of this position is to serve as the Responsible Pharmacist (RP) for the company and to exercise the professional, statutory and regulatory accountability required for the licensed manufacturing pharmacy and legal entity in South Africa. The RP ensures that the company and pharmacy operate in compliance with the Pharmacy Act, 53 of 1974, the Medicines and Related Substances Act, 101 of 1965, applicable regulations, Good Pharmacy Practice, relevant SAHPRA and SAPC requirements, and all conditions and limitations of the licenses held by the company.
In addition, the role provides focused SOQ management support by maintaining effective local product quality systems, coordinating product quality issue management, and overseeing outsourced GMP/GDP activities. These SOQ responsibilities are performed under the direction of the SOQ Sub-Cluster Lead, while the RP retains independent professional judgement and final accountability for matters reserved to the Responsible Pharmacist.
Responsible Pharmacist – statutory, license and legal-entity accountability
Act as registered with the South African Pharmacy Council and formally appointed as Responsible Pharmacist for the company
Exercise personal supervision and independent professional judgement over pharmacy activities and ensure compliance with the Pharmacy Act, Medicines and Related Substances Act, applicable regulations, Good Pharmacy Practice, GDP and relevant SAHPRA/SAPC requirements.
Ensure that the GMP-pharmacy license and SAHPRA license remain valid, accurate, and renewed on time, and that the SAPC and other authorities are informed as required
Ensure operations remain strictly within approved license conditions, including the non-stock-holding premises condition and the authorized import/export scope. Prevent unapproved testing, distribution, material handling, or storage at the licensed premises
Assess proposed changes to the legal entity, premises, responsible personnel, quality systems or licensed activities and ensure required regulatory notifications or prior approvals are obtained before implementation
Act as the official pharmaceutical contact and authorized signatory for SAHPRA, SAPC, the Department of Health and other competent authorities on matters requiring RP accountability.
Oversee and approve regulatory submissions, notifications, responses and commitments involving pharmacy or product-quality compliance, ensuring accuracy and completion within statutory timelines
Represent the legal entity during regulatory inspections and ensure observations; commitments and corrective actions are appropriately addressed and closed
Ensure documented deputy and delegation arrangements provide continuous statutory coverage during RP absence, without transferring the RP’s ultimate professional accountability
Provide professional pharmaceutical guidance to senior management and escalate any activity that may compromise patient safety, product quality, license compliance or the lawful conduct of the pharmacy
Exercise oversight and supervision of the Regulatory, Medical, Pharmacovigilance and other GxP functions for any submission, notification or interaction with the Board of Health (BoH), ensuring that all filings, responses and commitments are accurate, compliant and completed within the required statutory timelines
Responsible Pharmacist – product control and market decisions
Maintain full oversight of medicines imported or exported by the legal entity and confirm that activities comply with product registrations, permits, license conditions and applicable regulatory requirements
Hold final RP decision-making authority for returned medicines, including documented assessment and disposition as return to saleable stock, quarantine or destruction, in accordance with applicable legislation, GDP and company requirements
Authorize or provide required RP approval for product release, quarantine, rejection, destruction, recall, withdrawal and other market actions where pharmacist accountability is required
Ensure medicines are procured, stored, transported, distributed and documented through appropriately authorized third parties under effective quality agreements and RP oversight
Ensure appropriate controls for scheduled medicines, records, traceability and reconciliation, where applicable to the company’s authorized activities
Review and approve promotional, advertising, medical information and related materials or processes where RP review is legally or procedurally required
Ensure suspected quality defects, counterfeit or falsified products and significant compliance risks are promptly escalated, investigated and reported to authorities when required
SOQ Manager – local quality system and product quality support
Implement applicable SOQ procedures and maintain local product quality system aligned with company requirements and South African regulations
Coordinate deviations, product quality complaints, CAPAs, change controls, quality risk assessments, quarantine alerts and local market actions, escalating significant issues to the SOQ Sub-Cluster Lead within required timelines
Monitor key quality metrics and commitments, support periodic quality management reviews, and identify improvement actions
Coordinate required GMP/GDP training and support inspection of readiness, self-inspections and internal audits.
Support the local execution of Area Quality Review Team decisions and provide accurate market information when requested
Third-party quality oversight
Provide risk-based quality oversight of logistics service providers and other GMP/GDP contractors supporting the South African market
Ensure current quality agreements clearly define responsibilities, escalation pathways, RP authority, records access, returns management and regulatory obligations
Participate in contractor qualification, performance reviews, visits or audits as required, and track remediation of identified gaps
Ensure outsourced activities do not limit the RP’s access to information, independent judgement, supervision or final decision-making authority
Governance, collaboration and escalation
Collaborate with Regulatory, Medical, Pharmacovigilance, Supply Chain, Commercial, Legal and other functions while preserving the independence of the RP role.
Escalate significant product quality, patient safety, regulatory or license-compliance risks promptly to the Country President, SOQ Sub-Cluster Lead and relevant governance bodies
Maintain complete, accurate, contemporaneous and inspection-ready records demonstrating RP oversight, approvals and decisions
Ensure data integrity principles are applied to records and systems used for regulated activities
Backup and organizational support
Ensure that appropriate and documented delegation arrangements are implemented whenever the Responsible Pharmacist is absent or unavailable, to maintain continuous coverage of the Responsible Pharmacist activities
Ensure that delegated activities are assigned to an appropriately qualified and authorized individual in accordance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements
KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPI)
Maintains license and statutory compliance; completes required regulatory actions on time; ensures timely, documented RP decisions; closes quality commitments within due dates; and performs all duties in accordance with applicable SOPs and work instructions
Works according to relevant GSOP / GWI & Local SOPs
EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
Bachelor of Pharmacy (BPharm). Current registration as a pharmacist with the South African Pharmacy Council Eligibility for appointment and registration as Responsible Pharmacist for the legal entity. Advanced qualification in quality, regulatory affairs or business is preferred
At least 10 years of experience in the pharmaceutical or another highly regulated industry, including substantial experience in responsible pharmacist, quality, regulatory, supply or compliance activities. Demonstrated interaction with SAHPRA and/or SAPC is required

SAHPRA

supply operations

About the position
Role description:
As a Financial Accountant at the company, you will strengthen the company’s Finance & Legal operating capacity by providing a capable, technically grounded set of hands across audit support, tax support, statutory support, day-to-day finance execution and practical AI-enabled process improvement.
This is a hands-on generalist role for someone who is early in their career but already has strong accounting and finance foundations. You will help the company run a more controlled, compliant and scalable finance function across multiple African markets. You’ll work across legal entities, countries, advisers and internal teams to keep audits, filings, documentation, payment workflows and recurring finance processes moving.  The company is also looking for someone who is comfortable using AI tools to make finance work more scalable — either through existing practical proficiency in building tools, automation and better operating systems, or through a strong curiosity and enthusiasm to learn this deeply.
You will:
Support audits, tax and statutory work
: Help coordinate audit requests, tax submissions, statutory filings, governance records and supporting documentation across the companies group entities. You’ll make sure requests are logged, owners are clear, evidence is gathered, advisers are followed up and deadlines are visible.
Bring structure to messy finance workstreams
: Build and maintain practical trackers, calendars, checklists and document repositories for recurring Finance & Legal obligations. You’ll help turn scattered email threads, adviser comments and internal discussions into clear action plans.
Improve finance operations
: Support day-to-day finance workflows including payment processes, approval flows, reconciliation support, documentation packs, month-end support and recurring reporting tasks. You’ll be expected to spot opportunities to make these processes cleaner and more repeatable.
Use AI to build scalable systems
: Apply AI tools and automation thoughtfully within the Finance function — for example to summarise messy information, improve trackers, draft and maintain reusable documentation, build checklists, automate repeatable workflows, create better templates, and reduce manual rework.
Coordinate across countries and advisers:
Work with Finance team members, country owners, auditors, tax advisers, legal advisers, accountants and payment providers. You’ll need to follow up persistently, ask clear questions, and escalate blockers early.
Support cross-border finance topics
: Assist with practical work around intercompany balances, entity funding flows, FX exposure, upstreaming constraints, management recharges and related-party documentation, while escalating specialist judgement calls to senior finance leaders or external advisers.
Own commercial outcomes
: Being in Finance at company is not about sitting behind a spreadsheet. You’ll be expected to understand how finance, tax, governance and compliance work affects the real business, and to help make practical things happen.
Ideal background:
Education
: Accounting, finance, business, economics or related degree.
Professional background
: CA(SA), ACCA, CIMA, CPA, articles, audit background or equivalent professional training is strongly preferred. A recently qualified CA, CIMA or similar profile would be a strong fit.
Experience:
0-2 years of relevant post-training experience in audit, financial reporting, tax, governance, regulatory, financial services, fintech, lending, emerging markets or a multi-entity group environment. Financial Services background or experience is preferable.
Technical Skills:
Strong accounting and finance foundations; comfort with audit requests, reconciliations, filings, entity records, controls, financial documentation and spreadsheets. Familiarity with VAT, withholding tax, income tax, transfer pricing, statutory compliance or cross-border finance topics is advantageous.
AI and systems capability
: Practical comfort with AI tools, automation and modern productivity systems. Ideally, you have used AI personally or professionally to build useful tools, structure documentation, summarise information, analyse data, improve trackers, automate repeatable workflows or create more scalable operating systems. If you are not already highly proficient, you should be genuinely enthusiastic about becoming highly capable in this area and applying it to real Finance problems.
Execution Skills
: Highly organised and reliable, with the ability to manage many small moving pieces, define owners, set deadlines, track progress and escalate blockers.
Communication:
Clear and concise written communicator who can translate messy finance, adviser and internal inputs into structured summaries, trackers and action plans.
Mindset:
High ownership, strong bias to action, willingness to do unglamorous but important work, curiosity about how the business works, and motivation to build better finance infrastructure for a growing African asset-financing business. You should be excited by the opportunity to use technology and AI to build scalable, enduring Finance systems rather than simply repeating manual tasks.

Systems thinking
AI leveraging
Organisation
Analysis
Ownership

About the position
Set the standards, lead the people and build facilities systems that work nationally.
Is this you?
You're an assertive, highly organised facilities leader who communicates with confidence and gets to the point. Detail matters, but so does the bigger operational picture. You're proactive, commercially astute and comfortable holding regional teams and suppliers accountable. Strong systems, accurate reporting and permanent solutions are how you operate.
What you'll be doing (and why you'll enjoy it)
This newly created role puts you at the helm of facilities, technical infrastructure, security and operational readiness across a growing multi-site property portfolio. Rather than doing the maintenance yourself, you'll lead regional facilities teams and suppliers across CCTV, access control, security, maintenance, utilities, compliance and preventative maintenance. IT and networking require more direct technical involvement, including specifications, scope reviews and sign-off. Acting as 2IC on national operational matters, you'll work closely with senior leadership and Projects on new-site delivery. You'll enjoy the autonomy, scale and opportunity to build consistent national standards rather than simply react to problems.
Where you'll be doing it
You'll be joining a trailblazing organisation that is redefining the property landscape with its innovative serviced logistics parks. Recognised for its entrepreneurial culture and customer-first approach, the company creates spaces where businesses thrive. You'll be based in Cape Town CBD, with regular travel to business parks across Cape Town and Gauteng and being part of a collaborative, supportive team environment.
What you'll need
Strong multi-site facilities experience within commercial, industrial or logistics property is key, with Matric as a minimum. You'll need solid exposure to IT/networking, CCTV, access control, OHS, building infrastructure, supplier management and compliance. Project management exposure, particularly around new sites or infrastructure delivery, is important, alongside budgeting, CAPEX and the ability to read technical information. National experience is advantageous rather than essential. You'll need strong leadership experience and skills. Travel to Johannesburg, typically a few days per month and when operationally required, forms part of the role.
What you'll get
A basic salary and a possible performance-related bonus. Following successful probation, provident fund contributions are introduced. More importantly, this is an opportunity to step into a newly created national leadership role with genuine influence in a rapidly growing business.

We do respond to everyone! Just give us a few days to work through your application.

About the position
We are seeking a Project Manager for a short term contract (3-6 months), onsite.
The Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering priority business projects within agreed scope, time, cost, quality, risk, and stakeholder expectations. The role provides structured project management discipline across business-as-usual, operational improvement, regulatory, reporting, risk, control, systems, and transformation-related initiatives.
The role requires strong delivery ownership, practical governance, disciplined planning, proactive issue resolution, and clear communication with senior stakeholders, project teams, business owners, vendors, and delivery partners.
Key Accountabilities
PROJECT PLANNING AND DELIVERY
Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, assumptions, dependencies, and success criteria.
Develop and maintain integrated project plans, delivery schedules, RAID logs, decision logs, and action trackers.
Coordinate delivery activities across business, finance, technology, risk, compliance, audit, and vendor teams.
Apply agile or scrum management practices where appropriate, including sprint planning, backlog coordination, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and impediment tracking.
Work with product owners, business leads, and delivery teams to prioritise work, clarify requirements, manage backlogs, and maintain delivery momentum.
Monitor progress against agreed timelines and proactively manage risks, issues, dependencies, and constraints.
Ensure project outputs are delivered to the required quality and are accepted by the appropriate business owners.
GOVERNANCE, REPORTING AND CONTROLS
Establish practical project governance appropriate to the scale, complexity, and risk profile of each initiative.
Prepare clear project status reports, steering committee packs, progress updates, and escalation summaries.
Maintain accurate project documentation and ensure decisions, approvals, dependencies, and risks are traceable.
Support audit readiness, control discipline, and compliance with relevant internal policies and delivery standards.
Escalate material risks, unresolved decisions, and delivery blockers in a timely and structured manner.
STAKEHOLDER AND CHANGE MANAGEMENT
Build effective working relationships with senior stakeholders, business owners, delivery teams, and external partners.
Translate project objectives, risks, decisions, and progress into clear, audience-appropriate communication.
Facilitate workshops, working sessions, governance forums, and delivery check-ins.
Support adoption of project outputs by coordinating communication, readiness activities, handover, and transition planning.
Manage expectations constructively and maintain alignment between project teams and business priorities.
PROCESS, SYSTEMS AND VENDOR COORDINATION
Coordinate activities involving process improvement, reporting, controls, data, technology, and operational change.
Work with system owners, vendors, and delivery partners to track commitments, resolve issues, and meet agreed service expectations.
Identify opportunities to simplify ways of working, reduce duplication, and improve delivery efficiency.
Support implementation planning, testing coordination, business readiness, cutover activities, and post-implementation stabilisation where required.
Minimum Requirements
QUALIFICATIONS AND CERTIFICATIONS
Relevant degree or diploma in business, finance, commerce, accounting, information systems, project management, or a related discipline.
Formal project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, AgilePM, Scrum Master, PMI-ACP, or equivalent is preferred.
Additional qualifications in change management, process improvement, Lean Six Sigma, risk management, or business analysis would be advantageous.
EXPERIENCE
Minimum of 5 years’ project management experience, preferably in finance, operations, insurance, banking, financial services, professional services, or a regulated business environment.
Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional projects with senior stakeholders and multiple delivery teams.
Experience delivering initiatives linked to reporting, controls, audit, compliance, risk, process improvement, systems, data, or operational change.
Experience working with agile, hybrid, or waterfall delivery methods, with the ability to tailor the approach to the project context.
SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES
Strong project planning, coordination, governance, facilitation, and delivery management skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare concise executive-level updates.
Strong stakeholder management, influencing, problem-solving, and decision-support capability.
Ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, deadlines, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
Ability to maintain project discipline in a non-automated environment.
Good understanding of business processes, finance operations, reporting cycles, audit, controls, risk, and compliance environments.
Competence in project management tools, Microsoft Office applications, collaboration platforms, and project reporting templates.
KEY ATTRIBUTES
Organised, disciplined, and detail oriented.
Practical, delivery-focused, and comfortable working at pace.
Confident engaging with senior stakeholders and resolving delivery challenges constructively.
Analytical and commercially aware, with sound judgement and a solutions-focused mindset.
Collaborative, resilient, adaptable, and able to work across diverse teams and functions.
SUCCESS MEASURES
Projects delivered within agreed scope, timelines, budget, quality, and governance expectations.
Risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and actions are actively managed and clearly reported.
Stakeholders understand project progress, required decisions, and delivery implications.
Project documentation is complete, current, and suitable for governance, audit, and handover purposes.
Business outcomes are embedded through effective transition, readiness, and post-implementation support.

descriptions.title: Regional Finance Manager (JHB)
descriptions.description:
Regional Finance Manager (JHB)
Datafin
R Undisclosed
Permanent Management position
Johannesburg

Expires in 22 days

Save
