descriptions.title: BI Developer
descriptions.description:
Introduction

Amazing chance to join a Software Development company that develops software for the insurance industry. They are a medium size company that look after their staff and give recognition. They have been around for over 25 years and have an international footprint in London. They have a branch in London, Stellenbosch and Rosebank. They are extremely people orientated and offer a fun dynamic working environment.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Power BI Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the reporting and analytics solutions that turn platform data into insight for our clients, covering both new client implementations and the ongoing maintenance and enhancement of reporting for existing clients.
The role spans client-facing insurance reporting built on the platform (policy, premium, claims, and book-of-business analytics for insurers, MGAs, and brokers) as well as internal management information that supports decision-making across the company.
Reporting is delivered directly against the operational data model rather than a data warehouse. Dashboards are sourced from a dedicated non-production SQL Server reporting instance, where T-SQL stored procedures, views, and functions form a curated reporting layer that shapes, joins, and aggregates the data before it reaches Power BI. Strong T-SQL is therefore as important as strong Power BI in this role. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable writing and tuning set-based queries at the database and building the semantic models, DAX measures, and visualisations that sit on top of them.
Because dashboards are consumed by external clients as well as internal teams, controlling what each user can see is a core design responsibility rather than an afterthought. The Power BI Developer owns the access model behind every report: how users are authenticated, how client and tenant data is isolated, how row-level and object-level security are applied within the semantic model, and how workspace and app permissions govern distribution. Note that the gateway connects to the source SQL Server using a single least-privilege service account, so per-user entitlement cannot be enforced by database permissions and must be designed and proven within the semantic model.
Working closely with development, implementation, and business stakeholders, the Power BI Developer builds robust semantic models, well-crafted DAX measures, and performant, intuitive dashboards, ensuring that every report is accurate, secure, and trusted as a single source of truth.
KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS
1. Report & Dashboard Development
Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models for both client-facing insurance reporting and internal management information. Translate business and client requirements into clear, intuitive visualisations that make complex insurance data easy to understand and act on.
2. SQL Development & the Reporting Data Layer
Write, optimise, and maintain the T-SQL stored procedures, views, and functions that supply the dashboards from the non-production SQL Server reporting instance. Push joins, aggregation, and business logic down to the database so that Power BI consumes clean, report-ready result sets, and maintain this reporting layer as a stable contract that insulates dashboards from change in the underlying platform schema.
3. Semantic Modelling & DAX Development
Build and maintain robust, reusable semantic models, shaping normalised operational data into report-friendly star schemas. Develop accurate, well-structured DAX measures to support analysis of policy, premium, claims, and operational data, and select the appropriate storage mode (Import, DirectQuery, or composite) for each requirement.
4. Data Access, Security & Authentication
Design, implement, and test the access model that determines what each user can see. This covers authentication and identity through Microsoft Entra ID or, where reports are embedded in the   platform, service principal authentication with embed tokens and an asserted effective identity. It also covers dynamic row-level security driven by an entitlement model that reflects insurance access hierarchies such as broker, agency, branch, class of business, and delegated authority; object-level security to conceal sensitive tables and columns such as commission terms or claimant personal data; and least-privilege credentials for the gateway service account. Access control must be demonstrably tested before every release, not assumed.
5. Refresh, Deployment & Power BI Service Administration
Manage workspaces, on-premises data gateways, scheduled and incremental refresh, and the promotion of content across development, test, and production environments. Apply the correct workspace and app roles for internal and client audiences, recognising that elevated workspace roles bypass row-level security. Schedule refresh windows to respect the load profile of the source SQL Server, monitor refresh reliability, and resolve failures promptly.
6. Data Quality & Governance
Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of all reporting outputs. Apply data minimisation so that personal and sensitive data is only brought into a model where it is genuinely required for reporting, support sensitivity labelling and data residency requirements across UK and South African client bases, and support compliance with POPIA, GDPR, and   data governance standards.
7. Stakeholder Engagement & Requirements Analysis
Work closely with clients, implementation teams, and internal stakeholders to gather, analyse, and refine reporting requirements, including who is entitled to see what. Provide estimates, communicate progress clearly, and support users in adopting and getting value from reporting solutions.
8. Performance Optimisation, Documentation & Continuous Improvement
Monitor and optimise query, refresh, and report performance, from execution plans at the database through to visual render times in the report. Maintain clear documentation of the SQL reporting layer, semantic models, measures, and the access and entitlement model, follow and enhance BI standards and best practice, and stay current with the evolving Power BI and Microsoft Fabric ecosystem.

Desired Experience & Qualification

Bachelor’s degree or National Diploma in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
3 to 5 years’ experience in a BI development or data-centric role, with strong hands-on Power BI experience across Desktop and the Power BI Service.
Strong T-SQL development skills on Microsoft SQL Server, including writing and maintaining stored procedures, views, functions, and complex set-based queries against normalised transactional schemas.
Practical query tuning ability: reading execution plans, understanding indexing and query cost, and writing reporting queries that perform well without adversely affecting the source system.
Proven ability to shape normalised operational data into report-friendly models, applying star schema and dimensional modelling concepts within the Power BI semantic model.
Strong proficiency in DAX for measures and calculations, including filter context, time intelligence, correct handling of ratios, and security expressions, together with working knowledge of Power Query (M).
Practical understanding of Power BI storage modes (Import, DirectQuery, and composite models) and their implications, including the constraints that apply when a model is sourced from stored procedures.
Hands-on experience implementing row-level security, including dynamic RLS driven by an entitlement or bridge table and the use of functions such as USERPRINCIPALNAME and CUSTOMDATA, and the ability to test it credibly.
A working understanding of Power BI access and sharing mechanics: Microsoft Entra ID identity, workspace and app roles, and which roles enforce or bypass row-level security.
Sound security instincts around credentials and data access: least-privilege service accounts, secure storage of gateway and data source credentials, and awareness of what an export or a shared link can expose.
Experience administering the Power BI Service: workspaces, on-premises data gateways, scheduled refresh, row-level security, and deployment pipelines or an equivalent controlled promotion process.
The following are strongly preferred and will carry material weight in selection:
Experience delivering reporting within the insurance industry, whether at an insurer, MGA, broker, or insurance software vendor.
A working understanding of insurance data and terminology: the policy lifecycle (quote, bind, endorsement or mid-term adjustment, renewal, cancellation), premium, claims, commission, and reinsurance, together with the measures built from them such as gross written premium, earned premium, loss ratio, claims frequency and severity, retention, and new business conversion.
Comfort with effective-dated and point-in-time reporting: producing a correct view of the book as at a given date from a live transactional schema, including the treatment of mid-term adjustments and pro-rata earned premium.
Experience designing entitlement models for external users, particularly across broker, agency, and delegated authority hierarchies where a user may see their own book, their agency’s book, or a ceded share only.
Experience delivering reporting in a multi-tenant environment, and a view on when to isolate clients into separate workspaces and semantic models versus sharing a model secured by row-level security.
The following will be an advantage but not a minimum requirement:
Microsoft PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst) certification.
Experience with Power BI Embedded and the app-owns-data pattern: service principal authentication, embed token generation, and passing an effective identity so that security is enforced for users who hold no Power BI licence.
Object-level security, dynamic data masking, or comparable techniques for concealing sensitive columns and tables.
Experience with Power BI paginated reports (Report Builder / RDL) or SSRS, for operational and pixel-perfect outputs such as bordereaux, statements, and schedules.
Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels, Power BI audit and activity logging, tenant settings, and periodic access reviews.
Awareness of data residency and cross-border transfer considerations across UK and South African client bases.
Version control of Power BI artefacts (PBIP / TMDL in Git) and use of tools such as Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, and the Best Practice Analyzer.
Exposure to the Azure data stack (Azure SQL, Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric), as the reporting architecture is expected to evolve over time.
Experience in a SaaS or software implementation environment supporting multiple concurrent clients
SKILLS AND BEHAVIOUR REQUIRED
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with attention to detail and data accuracy.
Ability to translate business and client requirements into effective technical BI solutions.
Pragmatic about where logic belongs, with sound judgement on whether a calculation is best solved in T-SQL, Power Query, or DAX.
A security-first mindset, treating client data confidentiality as non-negotiable and defaulting to least privilege rather than convenience.
Clear communicator, able to present data insights and explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Mindful of the operational impact of reporting workloads on shared infrastructure, and disciplined about query cost and refresh timing.
Strong time management, able to prioritise and deliver across multiple concurrent projects and reporting requests.
Collaborative team player who works effectively with development, implementation, database, security, and client-facing teams.
Self-managed and proactive, with sound judgement on when to escalate risks or blockers.
High personal accountability and ownership.
Curious and committed to continuous learning across the BI and analytics landscape.

•    Income protector

Support the transition from an on-premise data warehouse towards
Microsoft Fabric

Work closely with the existing Power BI landscape.

Work with external consultants and outsourced technology partners where required.
Ensure appropriate technical standards, governance and architectural principles are maintained.
Remain sufficiently hands-on to understand the challenges faced by the development team and step in where necessary.
Support the wider organisation's data and reporting strategy.
Technical Environment
The ideal candidate will have experience across a combination of:
Data Warehousing
BI / Reporting
Microsoft Fabric
- highly advantageous
Data architecture and modelling
On-premise data environments
Cloud data platforms
Data integration and data contracts
Technical roadmap development

not a pure development role
.
What We're Looking For
We're looking for someone who can operate comfortably between
technical delivery, architecture, management and business engagement
.
You should have:
Strong experience in BI, data warehousing or a related technical environment.
Previous experience leading or managing technical teams.
Strong architectural understanding and the ability to make technical decisions.
Experience working with senior business and technical stakeholders.
The ability to understand complex technical discussions and confidently contribute to them.
A willingness to remain hands-on rather than purely managing from a distance.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
A genuine interest in developing and mentoring technical teams.
The ability to work across different areas rather than being narrowly focused on one technology.

financial reporting
would be advantageous. You don't necessarily need to be a finance specialist, but you should understand concepts such as
debits, credits, financial reporting and how financial data flows through reporting and EPM environments
.

Why This Role?
This is an opportunity to take a genuine leadership position within an evolving BI and data environment, rather than simply managing an existing platform.
You'll have the opportunity to:
Influence the
6-12 month technical roadmap
.
Play a key role in the move towards
Microsoft Fabric
.
Shape the architecture and future BI/EPM environment.
Develop and mentor an existing BI team.
Work across technical, strategic and business-facing responsibilities.
Make meaningful technical decisions rather than simply executing someone else's roadmap.
The ideal profile is someone from a consulting or technically diverse environment who is used to wearing multiple hats - technical lead, architect, developer, stakeholder manager and mentor - and wants to bring that experience into a permanent leadership position.

This role requires
four days per week in the office, Monday to Thursday

The team currently has
three BI developers

Looking for a ML Engineer to be the dedicated engineering partner for their Data Science team. This is a dual-discipline role sitting at the intersection of data engineering and machine learning operations — purpose-built to ensure our Data Scientists have the data they need to build models, and that those models reliably reach production.

Duties & Responsibilities

PLEASE READ THIS CAREFULLY BEFORE APPLYING
This is not a platform maintenance role.
You'll work directly alongside three Data Scientists building feature pipelines, productionising models and establishing the engineering standards that make AI work in a regulated insurance environment. If you're a engineer who's comfortable moving between data infrastructure and ML delivery, and who thrives when their work creates measurable business outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.
This role supports the Data Science team
— not the core Data Engineering function
Your primary stakeholders are  Data Scientists. You are their dedicated engineering partner. You will collaborate with our Data Engineering team on platform standards and shared infrastructure, but you are not responsible for the core data modernisation delivery backlog. That boundary is intentional and will be maintained.
Structure
60% Data Engineering
— building and maintaining the pipelines, feature datasets and Snowflake data assets your Data Scientists need to train and validate models.
40% ML Ops
— taking models from experimentation into production: deployment, versioning, monitoring and drift detection. Both disciplines serve one team: Data Science.
01  Data Engineering for AI & Data Science
You'll build and own the data infrastructure that powers the Data Science team  ensuring they always have clean, reliable, well-structured data to work with.
Design and build feature pipelines and training datasets that support model development and validation
Build and maintain high-quality data assets in Snowflake that serve AI and analytical workloads
Collaborate with Data Engineering to align on platform standards without absorbing core modernisation backlog

02  ML Ops & Model Productionisation
You'll close the gap between data science experimentation and production  ensuring models built by the team reach the business reliably and at scale.
Partner with Data Scientists to productionise machine learning models and AI solutions
Design, build and maintain ML deployment pipelines and model serving infrastructure
Implement CI/CD practices for machine learning workflows and automated model delivery
Manage model versioning, experiment tracking and reproducible deployments
Monitor deployed models for performance, data drift, reliability and operational health
Ensure model outputs, data lineage and deployment decisions are documented and auditable
Contribute to responsible AI practices — explainability, monitoring and model risk controls
Troubleshoot production issues and continuously improve model and pipeline performance
03  Engineering Standards & Collaboration
You will help establish the engineering rigour that makes AI work trustworthy and sustainable — across the Data Science team and the broader Data & AI function.
Help establish ML engineering standards and best practices for the Data Science team
Contribute to the architecture of our growing AI ecosystem across Azure and GCP environments
Work with Analytics Engineers to integrate ML outputs into analytical and operational data products

Be the go-to engineering partner for a high-performing Data Science team
Work with modern technologies including Azure, Snowflake, Python and dbt
Help shape our ML platform and productionisation standards from the ground up
See your engineering work translate directly into production AI that creates business value
Influence our AI ecosystem architecture as it scales across two insurance entities
Continuously learn and grow as AI and ML engineering evolve
Help build intelligent systems that improve how an insurance business operates every day
If you want a generalist platform role with no clear ownership, this probably isn't it.
If you want to be the engineering engine behind a Data Science team building real AI in insurance — we'd love to hear from you.

QUALIFICATIONS and EXPERIENCE
Relevant Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate, Azure Data Scientist Associate, or equivalent (preferred but not mandatory).

in AI/ML engineering, data science, or building AI-enabled solutions in a production environment.

developing and deploying LLM and/or generative AI solutions (e.g. RAG, chatbots, AI agents, intelligent document processing).
Experience integrating AI services into existing business applications, ideally within the Microsoft ecosystem (Azure, Power Platform, Microsoft 365).
Proven track record of delivering AI solutions that achieved measurable business outcomes.
Experience working in cross-functional teams alongside business stakeholders, developers, and data engineers.
KEY SKILLS
Strong proficiency in Python and common AI/ML libraries (e.g. scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, Semantic Kernel).
Hands-on experience with Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Azure AI Foundry.

Working knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse) and AI Builder / Copilot Studio.
Solid understanding of data engineering: SQL, APIs, data pipelines, and working with structured and unstructured data.
Familiarity with MLOps, version control (Git), CI/CD, and cloud deployment patterns.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and solution-design abilities.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; able to translate business needs into technical solutions and vice versa.
Awareness of Responsible AI principles, data privacy, and AI security best practices.
DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES
AI Solution Design & Development
Identify, evaluate, and prioritise AI/ML use cases across the business and translate them into deployable solutions.
Design, develop, and deploy AI models and intelligent applications using Python, Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, and related frameworks.
Build and fine-tune Large Language Model (LLM) solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, embeddings, and AI agents.
Develop predictive models, classification systems, computer vision pipelines, and intelligent document processing solutions where applicable.
Manage the full AI solution lifecycle: data exploration, model development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Integration With Existing Solutions
Embed AI capabilities into existing Microsoft Power Platform solutions (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Pages, Dataverse) using AI Builder, Azure AI Foundry, and custom connectors.
Integrate AI services into current line-of-business systems through APIs, custom connectors, Azure Functions, and Logic Apps.
Enhance Power BI reporting with AI-driven insights, forecasting, anomaly detection, and natural-language Q&A.
Build Copilot Studio agents and conversational interfaces that interact with internal systems and data sources.
Data Engineering & MLOps
Work with structured and unstructured data sources to prepare, clean, and engineer features for AI models.
Implement MLOps practices including version control, CI/CD for models, monitoring, drift detection, and responsible retraining.
Ensure AI solutions are secure, scalable, observable, and aligned with cloud architecture best practices on Microsoft Azure.
Cross-functional Collaboration & Adoption
Partner with departments to understand workflows and identify where AI can deliver measurable impact.
Collaborate with the Digital Transformation team to align AI initiatives with the broader digital roadmap.
Provide user training, documentation, and ongoing support to drive adoption of AI-enabled tools.
Communicate complex AI concepts in clear, business-friendly language to non-technical stakeholders.
AI Governance, Ethics & Risk
Apply Responsible AI principles: fairness, transparency, accountability, privacy, and security.
Establish and enforce governance frameworks for AI usage, including data handling, model approval, and acceptable-use policies.
Monitor model performance, bias, and hallucination risks; implement guardrails for generative AI solutions.
Ensure compliance with POPIA, Company Group standards, and applicable data protection and security requirements.
Innovation & Continuous Improvement
Stay current with advances in AI, generative models, agentic systems, and the Microsoft AI stack.
Lead AI proofs-of-concept and pilots, then scale successful initiatives enterprise-wide.
Review existing systems and recommend AI-driven enhancements that improve performance, accuracy, or user experience.

Manage multiple AI initiatives concurrently from conception through deployment and handover.
Produce technical and functional documentation including solution architecture, data flows, model cards, SOPs, and support guides.
Ensure adherence to company standards, security requirements, and statutory regulations.

descriptions.title: Application Support Engineer

A well-established South African insurance organisation with a data-centric technology environment and a growing focus on internally developed applications and digital capability. The business operates in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where technical excellence, accountability, innovation and practical problem-solving are valued
Description
Application Support Engineer | Parktown, Johannesburg | Permanent
Keep critical applications stable, solve complex production issues and work at the intersection of software, data and cloud technology. This is an opportunity for a technically strong support engineer to take real ownership of application performance and production incidents within a growing technology environment.
The Application Support Engineer will provide hands-on Tier 2 and Tier 3 support across core business applications, investigating incidents, diagnosing defects and performance issues, and driving problems through to resolution or accurate escalation. The role requires someone who is comfortable moving between application logs, source code, databases, cloud environments and stakeholder conversations.
You will work closely with development, data and delivery teams to identify root causes, provide technical workarounds, support production fixes and improve the overall reliability of internally developed and partner-built applications. With the technology environment evolving towards Google Cloud Platform, this role offers exposure to cloud migration, data-intensive applications, automation and modern DevOps practices.
The client is a well-established insurance organisation with a technology environment increasingly focused on data, digital solutions and internally developed applications. Its culture values excellence, practical innovation, accountability, collaboration and people who take ownership and make things happen.
What You'll Do
• Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 application and production support.
• Own incidents from initial investigation through resolution or technically accurate escalation.
• Diagnose application failures, bugs, performance issues and data inconsistencies.
• Analyse application logs, performance metrics, system behaviour and data flows to identify root causes.
• Read, troubleshoot and debug Python code and investigate relevant React code where required.
• Work with development teams to reproduce and escalate complex application defects.
• Provide detailed technical findings, reproduction steps and recommended workarounds.
• Investigate issues across application, database, cloud and infrastructure layers.
• Query and troubleshoot production data using SQL.
• Support applications through the migration from on-premises infrastructure to Google Cloud Platform.
• Develop scripts and internal tools to automate repetitive support activities.
• Contribute to deployment and CI/CD processes and broader DevOps practices.
• Document incidents, troubleshooting procedures, workarounds and known errors.
• Develop technical knowledge-base content to improve support capability.
• Communicate technical issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Work with data engineers, analytics engineers, developers and partner delivery teams to improve application reliability.
What You Bring
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
• At least 3 years' experience in Application Support, Technical Solutions Engineering, Cloud Support or a closely related environment.
• Strong hands-on application or production support experience.
• Strong Python capability, including the ability to read, write and debug code.
• Experience with Python web frameworks such as Flask or FastAPI is advantageous.
• Strong SQL capability, including the ability to safely query and modify production data.
• Practical experience with cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS or Azure.
• Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, routing and load balancing.
• Understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code.
• Exposure to Terraform or similar IaC technologies.
• Experience with distributed systems and microservices architectures.
• Experience with Docker and containerised environments.
• Strong analytical and root-cause problem-solving ability.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across technical teams.
• High attention to detail, professionalism and discretion.
• Ability to remain structured and effective under pressure.
GCP, BigQuery, React, strong data-warehouse experience and insurance or financial-services exposure will be advantageous.
What Success Looks Like
• Production incidents are investigated methodically and resolved efficiently.
• Root causes are identified rather than symptoms simply being addressed.
• Technical issues are accurately diagnosed across application, data, cloud and infrastructure layers.
• Developers and delivery teams receive clear, actionable information when issues require escalation.
• Application reliability and production stability improve over time.
• Repetitive support activities are reduced through practical automation.
• Incident knowledge, workarounds and technical documentation remain accurate and accessible.
• Business stakeholders receive clear communication during incidents and understand the impact and resolution.
• You become a trusted technical point of escalation for complex application and production issues.
• You contribute effectively as the organisation continues its transition towards a cloud-based technology environment.

The position is accountable for the quality, integrity and defensibility of its analysis and measurement, rather than ownership of every operational action or business benefit resulting from its recommendations.
The specialist will provide analytical and service-value support to Account Executives, Service Delivery Managers, programme teams and project stakeholders, while maintaining clearly defined accountability boundaries. We’re looking for a passionate a Data Warehouse Engineer (SQL Server + Python) that will build and automates data warehouse solutions using SQL Server and Python, with exposure to Microsoft Fabric as an emerging analytics platform. This role will improve reliability and automation of DW delivery through scripted ETL/ELT, data-quality checks, and audit logging, and supports gradual Fabric adoption by integrating Python workflows where applicable.

Hello Group
Offers
Onsite Barista
– Because life’s too short for bad coffee!

– Work hard, play harder!

Duties & Responsibilities

1. SQL Server DW Development
Develop and maintain SQL Server DW structures (tables, views, stored procedures) in line with team standards (Sandbox → Extract → Transform). Support DWIntake-driven delivery including source onboarding, target naming, schedules, and production handover.
2. Python ETL/ELT Automation
Automate ETL/ELT processes using Python (pandas, pyodbc, SQLAlchemy). Build reusable scripts for extracts, transforms, loads, file/API ingestion, and scheduled jobs with robust connectivity, failure handling, and recoverable run design.
3. Data Quality & Audit Logging
Implement data-quality checks in Python scripts and pipelines to prevent bad data landing in the DW. Design audit logging so runs are recoverable, traceable, and reviewable. Support Table Compare and monitoring workflows for assigned datasets.
4. Fabric Enablement
Contribute to Fabric adoption by integrating Python workflows where applicable (notebooks, orchestration helpers, validation scripts). Collaborate with Fabric-focused colleagues on parity, testing, and handoff between SQL Server and Fabric artefacts.
5. Operational Support & Incidents
Respond to operational incidents for owned scripts and jobs. Escalate Finance vs DW ownership correctly. Maintain high reliability of owned scheduled processes.
6. Source Control & Collaboration
Use Git for all owned code with clear commit discipline and rollback paths. Collaborate with DW and BI teams; assist with onboarding on Python automation patterns used by the team.
7. Governance & Documentation
Apply DW governance practices: naming, documentation, and clear ownership of automated processes. Ensure production changes are traceable to intake/Jira references.
8. Stakeholder Delivery
Deliver assigned intake and automation work within agreed timelines. Communicate delays proactively and support BI/data availability queries timeously.

Desired Experience & Qualification

Education
National Diploma / Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or equivalent — OR equivalent demonstrable DW / data-engineering experience. Python / data-engineering certifications preferred. Microsoft Fabric or Azure Data training advantageous.
Experience
3–5 years SQL Server experience (T-SQL, stored procedures, indexing, performance tuning). Minimum 1 year practical Python for data engineering (ETL/ELT automation, APIs; pandas, pyodbc / SQLAlchemy). Experience implementing data-quality checks and audit logging in scripts/pipelines. FinTech / high-volume transactional experience highly desirable.
Technical Knowledge
Strong SQL Server (SSMS / T-SQL). Proficiency in Python for data engineering. Git and scripting practices that support auditability and rollback. Solid DW concepts and governance. Preferred: Microsoft Fabric (pipelines, lakehouse, warehouse), cloud data integration tools, Power BI handoff.
Analytical Skills
Ability to diagnose script and SQL failures methodically, distinguish root cause from symptoms, and design checks that prevent bad data rather than fixing after the fact.
Communication
Clear verbal and written communication with DW, BI, and Finance stakeholders. Able to explain technical issues and timelines to non-specialists.
Work Style
Organised, audit-minded, and delivery-focused. Comfortable working in a small team with clear ownership. Able to prioritise under operational time pressure.
Systems Exposure
SQL Server; Python (pandas, pyodbc, SQLAlchemy); Git; ETL/ELT and data-quality frameworks; APIs; Microsoft Fabric (preferred); Hello Group DW tooling (DWIntake, Procedure Monitor, Table Compare) as applicable.

t to join their team.

Support data-driven and AI-assisted decision-making across the organisation.
Provide light-touch training and share best practices on analytics and AI tools with team members.

You are an out-of-the-box thinker, a brilliant multi-tasker, have a natural aptitude for organising and are always keen to solve tricky problems with some creative ideas. You are equally happy digging through a large dataset in SQL as you are experimenting with a new AI model to see what it can do.

descriptions.title: Finance Data Model & Chart of Accounts Design Lead
descriptions.description:
Duties & Responsibilities

We are seeking a highly experienced
Finance Transformation professional
to lead the design of a future-state Finance Data Model and Chart of Accounts as part of a major Finance Transformation programme.
The successful candidate will define the organisation’s future Chart of Accounts, reporting dimensions, financial hierarchies, master-data standards, governance frameworks and supporting finance data structures.
These structures must enable effective:
Statutory and regulatory reporting
Management and performance reporting
Planning, budgeting and forecasting
Group consolidation and reporting
Finance process standardisation
ERP and EPM implementation
Data governance and financial control
Future finance operating models
This role requires someone who combines deep finance and accounting expertise with proven finance-transformation delivery experience.
The successful candidate must be able to work across Finance, Tax, Actuarial, Technology, Data, Risk and business teams, translating complex requirements into scalable and implementable finance structures.
This is a high-impact position requiring both strategic leadership and hands-on design capability.
Key Responsibilities
Finance Data Model Design
Lead the design of the future-state Finance Data Model.
Define the Chart of Accounts, reporting dimensions, hierarchies and consolidation structures.
Design legal-entity, cost-centre, profit-centre, organisational and business-unit structures.
Define appropriate product, channel and management-reporting dimensions.
Establish finance master-data principles and standards.
Ensure the model supports statutory, regulatory, management and operational reporting.
Develop design principles that ensure consistency, scalability, governance and sustainability.
Ensure that the future-state design supports business growth, transformation and future technology initiatives.
Chart of Accounts Redesign
Lead the review and redesign of the organisation’s Chart of Accounts.
Assess the existing Chart of Accounts and identify opportunities to simplify and standardise its structure.
Ensure that the future design supports financial reporting, regulatory reporting, consolidation, performance management, planning and forecasting.
Define account structures, segments, hierarchies, attributes and roll-up rules.
Ensure the design supports data analytics and business-intelligence requirements.
Develop a mapping strategy from current-state accounts and structures to the future-state design.
Assess the impact of the proposed design on reporting, processes, systems, controls and users.
Finance Transformation and Operating Model Alignment
Align the Finance Data Model with the broader Finance Target Operating Model.
Support the design of future-state finance processes and organisational structures.
Ensure alignment across Record-to-Report, Group Reporting, Planning and Forecasting, Performance Management and Finance Data Governance.
Support the development of Shared Services, Centres of Excellence and finance ownership models.
Identify opportunities to simplify and standardise finance processes through improved data design.
Business Analysis and Requirements Management
Facilitate workshops with senior stakeholders to gather, analyse and validate requirements.
Lead requirements analysis across Finance, Tax, Actuarial, Technology, Data and business teams.
Translate reporting, accounting and operational requirements into practical finance-data structures.
Produce comprehensive business requirements and design specifications.
Develop data dictionaries, process maps, impact assessments and design-authority documentation.
Maintain traceability between business requirements, design decisions and implementation outcomes.
Document key decisions, assumptions, dependencies and unresolved matters.
Finance Data Governance
Design an appropriate Finance Data Governance framework.
Define data ownership, accountability and stewardship responsibilities.
Establish approval workflows and governance forums.
Define finance master-data maintenance procedures.
Develop data-quality standards and control frameworks.
Establish governance mechanisms for future changes to accounts, dimensions, hierarchies and master data.
Ensure that the future model can be governed and maintained after implementation.
Stakeholder Engagement and Facilitation
Partner with senior stakeholders across Finance, Tax, Actuarial, Technology, Risk, Compliance and Operations.
Facilitate design workshops, working sessions and decision-making forums.
Challenge existing structures and approaches where appropriate.
Guide stakeholders toward practical, scalable and best-practice solutions.
Present recommendations and design decisions to Executive Sponsors, Steering Committees and programme governance forums.
Build agreement across stakeholder groups with differing reporting and operational requirements.
Act as a trusted advisor on finance transformation, data design and reporting architecture.
Transformation Delivery Support
Support implementation planning and delivery activities.
Identify design risks, dependencies, impacts and implementation considerations.
Validate that proposed technology solutions support the approved finance design.
Define transition and implementation roadmaps.
Support the development of the finance data-migration strategy.
Establish requirements for migrating finance master data and historical reporting structures.
Support testing, training, change management and business-readiness activities.
Provide subject-matter expertise throughout the transformation lifecycle.
Ensure that all proposed designs are practical, controlled and implementable.
Key Deliverables
The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering:
A comprehensive future-state Finance Data Model blueprint
A detailed future-state Chart of Accounts
Reporting dimensions, attributes, hierarchies and roll-up structures
Finance data-design principles and standards
A Finance Data Governance and ownership framework
A finance master-data control and maintenance model
A current-to-future Chart of Accounts mapping strategy
Data-migration requirements and design principles
Reporting, process, system and control impact assessments
A stakeholder decision and design register
A future-state reporting architecture
An implementation and transition roadmap
Required Experience
Extensive experience in Finance Transformation, Finance Architecture, Finance Systems, Financial Reporting, Financial Control or a related discipline.
Proven experience leading enterprise Chart of Accounts redesign initiatives within large and complex organisations.
Strong experience designing finance data models that support multiple legal entities, business units, products and reporting requirements.
Experience defining reporting dimensions, hierarchies, attributes and roll-up structures.
Strong exposure to ERP, EPM, financial consolidation or enterprise-transformation programmes.
Experience aligning finance-data structures with Finance Target Operating Models and process-transformation initiatives.
Demonstrated experience developing current-to-future mapping and data-migration strategies.
Strong understanding of statutory, regulatory, management and group-reporting requirements.
Proven experience facilitating workshops with senior and executive stakeholders.
Experience driving complex design decisions across multiple stakeholder groups.
Demonstrated ability to translate business and reporting requirements into scalable design solutions.
Strong programme-delivery experience within complex transformation environments.
Experience producing detailed design documentation and implementation roadmaps.
Qualifications
Relevant degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce or a related field.
A recognised professional finance qualification such as
CA(SA), CIMA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent
is preferred.
Finance Transformation, ERP, EPM, data-management or process-related qualifications would be advantageous.
Technical Knowledge
The ideal candidate should demonstrate strong expertise across several of the following areas:
Chart of Accounts design
Finance data architecture
Finance master-data management
Financial accounting and control
Financial and management reporting
Statutory and regulatory reporting
Group consolidation
Finance Target Operating Models
Data governance and data quality
Planning, budgeting and forecasting
Performance management
Record-to-Report and financial close processes
ERP and EPM solution design
Reporting dimensions and hierarchies
Finance data migration
Business intelligence and enterprise reporting
Preferred Industry Experience
Experience within one or more of the following sectors would be advantageous:
Insurance
Financial services
Banking
Wealth and asset management
Other large or highly regulated industries
Preferred Technology Exposure
Exposure to one or more of the following platforms would be advantageous:
Oracle EPM
OneStream
Workday
Anaplan
Hyperion
Microsoft Dynamics
Microsoft Great Plains
Workiva
Power BI
Enterprise reporting and consolidation platforms

Finance, Data, Model, Chart, Accounts, Design, Lead, contract, onsite, JHB

descriptions.description:
Unique Personnel boasts over 50 years (established in 1970) of personnel and staffing experience, so it's not surprising that even though our main focus has been providing on South African Staffing Solutions, we now recruit internationally for over 5000 clients

Duties & Responsibilities

Job Purpose
To act as the Executive Head's right hand and run the hub as a high-performing operating unit.
The HR Business Manager translates the hub's strategy and key focus areas into an executed, governed and cost-disciplined operation - owning its performance and governance posture, holding delegated budget authority, leading its operations team, and deputising for the Executive Head.
The HR Business Manager owns the hub's operating rhythm, financial oversight, internal communications, team events and operational reporting for the hub - freeing the Executive Head and the HR leadership team from administration so they can spend their time on strategy, partnering, capability building and talent.
Job Responsibilities
Hub operating strategy and leadership
Translates the Executive Head’s strategy into an integrated hub operating plan with clear priorities, owners and milestones, and drives delivery to outcome.
Serves as part of hub leadership, prepares key decisions, drives governance cadence and deputises for the Executive Head in defined forums.
Provides challenge and decision support to the leadership team beyond administration.
Hub operating rhythm and coordination
Owns the hub’s meeting and governance cadence, aligned to People governance and reporting forums.
Coordinates agendas, submissions, decisions and actions across HR Executives, Heads and Strategic HRBPs to ensure meetings are well prepared and actions are closed.
Maintains current plans, commitments and action logs as the team’s single source of truth.
Budget authority and cost-to-serve accountability
Holds delegated authority for the hub cost centre within the Executive Head’s mandate and makes operating-spend decisions within that delegation.
Accountable for cost-to-serve, continuous cost optimisation, efficiency and productivity.
Owns business-case discipline for hub investments and resourcing decisions.
Governance, risk and assurance posture
Accountable for the hub’s governance and control environment, including the risk register and closure of audit and assurance actions.
Engages Audit, People Risk and relevant regulators on hub operating and people-data governance matters.
Ensures decisions, records and controls are sound and defensible.
Performance, insight and decision support
Owns the hub performance framework and scorecard, working with the Specialist: Data and Analytics to turn data into decisions.
Tracks progress, closes actions and escalates material issues to the Executive Head and enterprise leadership.
Provides decision-ready analysis on the hub’s most material choices
Team leadership and operating capability
Leads the hub operations team, including the Specialist and Team Coordinator, sets standards and builds operating capability.
Drives continuous improvement and change in how the hub works.
Represents the hub operationally to Shared Services, CoE and business HR Executive Heads.
Internal communications and team experience
Runs hub internal communications, including team updates, leadership messages and wider HR or business communications as needed.
Plans and delivers team events, offsites and engagement moments with the Team Coordinator.
Supports team experience through onboarding logistics, tools, access, workspace and day-to-day operational needs.
Operational reporting and pack coordination
Coordinates operational reports and leadership packs with the Specialist: Data and Analytics and Heads.
Tracks operational metrics and success measures, including FTE ratios, cost-to-serve, cadence adherence, risk and transformation.
Ensures packs are accurate, consistent, current and on time.

Preferred Qualification
Degree in Business, Finance, HR or a related field.
Postgraduate qualification (MBA / business) advantageous.
Finance, governance or transformation credential beneficial.
Project/PMO, financial management or business administration certification beneficial.
Minimum Experience Level
8 - 12 years' experience including chief-of-staff, COO / business-management, transformation or senior operations-leadership roles.
Proven delegated budget and governance accountability, and leadership of a team or operating unit.
Track record of turning strategy into governed, cost-disciplined delivery in a large, regulated or matrixed organisation

Operating-model and business-plan execution
Delegated financial management and cost optimisation
Governance, risk and assurance

About PepsiCo
PepsiCo products are enjoyed by consumers more than one billion times a day in more than 200 countries and territories around the world. PepsiCo generated more than $79 billion in net revenue in 2021, driven by a complementary beverage and convenient foods portfolio that includes Lay's, Doritos, Cheetos, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Mountain Dew, Quaker, and SodaStream. PepsiCo's product portfolio includes a wide range of enjoyable foods and beverages, including many iconic brands that generate more than $1 billion each in estimated annual retail sales.
Guiding PepsiCo is our vision to Be the Global Leader in Beverages and Convenient Foods by Winning with PepsiCo Positive (pep+). pep+ is our strategic end-to-end transformation that puts sustainability and human capital at the center of how we will create value and growth by operating within planetary boundaries and inspiring positive change for planet and people.
In South Africa (SA), you will find our products across the region at breakfast, lunch, or dinner. At the gym or on the field. In the office or on the go. .

IGrow Wealth Investments Group of Companies
, proudly positioned as
South Africa’s #1 Investment company,
is seeking a

to join our team in
Durbanville, Cape Town.
The
Software Developer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining features across the full technology stack of our web platform. The role works across the React/TypeScript frontend, the Node.js/Express backend, and the PostgreSQL database layer, taking ownership of features from specification through to production deployment. Having grown beyond junior responsibilities, this role is expected to deliver production-ready features independently, contribute to technical decisions, handle deployments through our CI/CD pipeline, and integrate the platform with third-party services such as PayFast and transactional email providers.

Duties & Responsibilities

Minimum requirements (Advantageous):
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree (BSc) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related field.
Experience
Minimum 8 years of professional software development experience.
Demonstrated experience building and maintaining production web applications across the full stack.
Proven track record of shipping features from specification through to deployment.
Experience working in a Git-based collaborative development environment.
Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web development frameworks and tools, including React 18, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Vite, React Router, TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Zod, Framer Motion, and Leaflet.
Experience developing secure REST APIs, authentication, file uploads, transactional email, payment gateway integrations, and web application security best practices.
Understanding of REST API design principles and HTTP fundamentals.
Experience working with Git workflows, including feature branches, pull requests, and code reviews.
Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of features from concept through deployment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to discuss technical trade-offs effectively.
Collaborative mindset with experience participating in code reviews.
Self-motivated learner who keeps up to date with modern JavaScript, React, and Node.js development practices.
Reliable, accountable, and proactive in identifying and communicating blockers or risks early.
Duties and responsibilities include, but not limited to:
Translate product requirements, specifications, wireframes, and UI/UX designs into high-quality, production-ready frontend features.
Design, build, and maintain modern web applications using React and TypeScript.
Develop reusable, maintainable, and well-structured components that can be shared across features and applications.
Build responsive, accessible, and intuitive user interfaces that work consistently across modern desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers.
Convert UI/UX designs into accurate, polished interfaces while maintaining a consistent visual language across the product.
Implement appropriate application architecture, component composition, state management, routing, data fetching, caching, and form-management patterns.
Build complex forms and user workflows, including validation, conditional behaviour, multi-step processes, error handling, and user feedback.
Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and services, including authentication, file uploads, payments, mapping, notifications, and other third-party services.
Work with REST APIs and other service interfaces, correctly handling authentication, pagination, validation errors, loading states, retries, failures, and asynchronous operations.
Implement secure authentication and authorisation flows in conjunction with backend services, ensuring appropriate handling of sessions, permissions, and protected application areas.
Apply frontend security best practices, including input handling, dependency management, secure browser storage practices, and protection against common web application vulnerabilities.
Design frontend solutions that accommodate changing requirements and future functionality without unnecessary complexity or excessive coupling.
Optimise applications for performance, including rendering efficiency, network usage, application loading time, asset optimisation, and perceived user responsiveness.
Implement appropriate client-side error handling and provide clear, useful feedback when operations fail.
Integrate file and image upload functionality, including validation, progress indication, previews, and error handling where required.
Implement interactive functionality such as maps, dashboards, data visualisations, search, filtering, dynamic forms, and other rich application experiences as required by the product.
Work closely with backend engineers to define and refine API contracts, data structures, authentication flows, and integration requirements.
Collaborate with product owners, designers, engineers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and identify practical technical solutions.
Participate in technical discussions and contribute to decisions regarding frontend architecture, application structure, reusable components, and engineering standards.
Write clean, readable, maintainable, and appropriately documented TypeScript and React code.
Write and maintain appropriate automated tests for components, application logic, integrations, and critical user journeys.
Diagnose and resolve defects reported by users, internal stakeholders, automated testing, or application monitoring.
Investigate and resolve browser-specific, device-specific, performance, usability, and accessibility issues.
Refactor and improve existing frontend code to reduce technical debt, improve maintainability, and simplify future development.
Review code contributed by other developers and provide constructive feedback on correctness, maintainability, usability, security, and overall engineering quality.
Participate in source-control and code-review processes, including producing meaningful commits, pull requests, and supporting technical documentation.
Work effectively within automated build, testing, deployment, and CI/CD processes and assist in diagnosing issues affecting frontend releases.
Ensure frontend applications are configurable across local, development, staging, and production environments without embedding environment-specific configuration in application code.
Maintain awareness of modern React and TypeScript development practices and recommend improvements where they provide clear technical or product value.
Take ownership of assigned features from initial requirements through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
Contribute to the continued improvement of frontend engineering standards, development practices, tooling, and overall product quality.

descriptions.title: Software Developer (GraphQL Focus)
descriptions.description:
Introduction

The Software Developer (GraphQL Focus) is a domain-specialized software engineer responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing unified GraphQL API layers to streamline data consumption across diverse web and mobile platforms. Operating at the direct intersection of client-side user experience, backend microservices, and enterprise data graph orchestration, this developer acts as a bridge engineer who eliminates data over-fetching/under-fetching and standardizes frontend-to-backend data delivery. The position requires a focused developer with expert knowledge of schema definition languages, resolver execution logic, and graph federations, alongside a deep understanding of frontend state management.

Duties & Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain clean, extendable GraphQL schemas, custom types, mutations, subscriptions, and directive definitions across client applications.
Write, test, and optimize asynchronous resolver functions that seamlessly bind GraphQL endpoints to underlying microservices, REST APIs, and direct database layers.
Implement graph federation solutions (e.g. Apollo Federation) and schema stitching to consolidate disparate backend services into a single, unified data graph.
Diagnose and resolve problem and resource exhaustion risks using batching, caching strategies, and tools like DataLoader and Redis.
Configure, monitor, and enforce query complexity analysis, depth limiting, and field-level access control to protect the GraphQL engine against denial-of-service threats.
Collaborate directly with React, React Native, Angular, and mobile application teams to structure query schemas aligned precisely with client state requirements.
Maintain comprehensive schema documentation, interactive playground environments, and developer tooling to simplify frontend team onboarding and adoption.
Continuously monitor and profile GraphQL engine operations, tracing query field execution latencies and optimizing payload transport efficiency.
Implement client-side and server-side caching policies (Apollo Client / Relay) to minimize redundant network round-trips and optimize offline data handling.
Participate actively in agile ceremonies, providing accurate task estimations, schema design reviews, and continuous improvement inputs within Jira.

Desired Experience & Qualification

National Diploma, Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related field.
A minimum of 3 to 5 years of commercial software development experience, with at least 2+ years dedicated hands-on experience building production GraphQL layers.
Mastery of the modern GraphQL stack, including Apollo Server/Client, GraphQL Java, Hasura, Prisma, or TypeGraphQL, using TypeScript/Node.js or Java.
Relevant cloud or developer certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Developer, Apollo GraphQL Developer Certification) are advantageous.
Experience in IT Consulting or Telecommunications domains will be advantageous.
In-depth understanding of API paradigms, contrasting GraphQL with REST, gRPC, and SOAP architectures in terms of performance and network overhead.
Demonstrated proficiency using DataLoader, Redis, and query caching implementations to eliminate performance bottlenecks in graph traversal.
Solid experience integrating GraphQL layers with modern frontend frameworks (React, Next.js, React Native, or Angular) and state management libraries.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset, with a proven ability to isolate execution bottlenecks across multi-layered distributed query graphs.
Excellent collaborative and communication skills, with a track record of creating clear schema documentation and establishing smooth developer workflows between teams.

Adaptable, proactive and solution-driven in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.

Its headquarters are in Cape Town, while its telescopes are at Sutherland in the semi-arid Northern Cape. Distributed between the two sites, SAAO employs roughly 130 people, many of them scientists and engineers, and is contracted to operate the 10-m Southern African Large Telescope (SALT), on behalf of the international SALT Foundation. SAAO is the premier optical/infrared research facility on the African continent, with global research and outreach collaborations and contributing human capacity development for South Africa.

South Africa Astronomical Observatory (SAAO)

The position is within a dynamic division, comprised of approximately three dozen staff, including astronomers, electrical, electronic, optical and mechanical engineers, technicians, and software developers.

Assist with software development and maintenance in accordance with the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)

Work closely with engineers and multidisciplinary teams

Problem-solving mindset and adaptability

descriptions.title: Mining Digitalisation Software Sales
descriptions.description:
Introduction

Read this part first.
We do not need a sales manager. We do not need someone to build a team, write a strategy deck, or spend six months “understanding the landscape.”
We need one person who can walk into a mine, hold a room of executives and engineers, and close.
If that is what you do — and you are tired of doing it inside a structure that takes credit for it, caps what you earn on it, or makes you wait three months for a pricing approval from a head office in another hemisphere — keep reading.
You will need three things: you know mining, you know the people, and you can hold a technical conversation without a pre-sales engineer in the room.
About our company
A software solutions business with over a decade of delivery behind it, now scaling hard. Our technology runs at mines across multiple continents.
Engineering-led. Privately held. We build and support our own product — not a reseller, not a consultancy with a software side-line, and not a regional office waiting on permission from a foreign parent.
Decisions get made in days, by people who understand mining. That matters more than it sounds when you are trying to close.
About our products
An integrated operations platform for mines: fleet management, production, maintenance, fuel and energy, operational reporting, workflow automation and systems integration — connected modules on one platform, rather than five vendors and an integration project nobody signed up for.
Where we win
Integration-friendly, technology-agnostic.
We connect to what the mine already runs — mixed OEM fleets, existing ERPs, legacy control systems, whatever is on site. No rip-and-replace, no forced standardisation on our hardware, no telling a customer their working equipment is now the problem.
Configurable to the operation, not the other way round.
Enterprise-grade software that adapts to how a mine actually works, rather than forcing the mine to work the way the software was built. Every operation is different. Most vendors treat that as a customisation project with a price tag; we treat it as the point.
AI where it earns its place.
Not a decade-old codebase with a chatbot bolted on. AI sits in the foundation — accelerating configuration, surfacing what matters in operational data — because the platform was built recently enough to do it properly.
Modularity.
A mine starts with one module and expands as value is proven. No monolithic, multi-year, all-or-nothing programme that has to survive three budget cycles before anyone sees a benefit.
Deployment speed.
Customers are looking at production data while competitors are still in workshop phase.
That is a differentiated story, and it is a story that closes. You will not be selling on price.

Duties & Responsibilities

The role
You will personally identify, develop, negotiate and close mining-technology opportunities in South Africa and selected African markets.
This is a closing role. No team beneath you, none planned, nothing to manage but your own pipeline.
You will work directly with our Business Development and Product leads, with technical specialists running discovery, demonstrations and solution design. You own the commercial outcome. They own the technical proof. You will not be building your own decks or fielding architecture questions alone at 11pm.
You inherit an active pipeline and an existing South African customer base to expand into. You are not starting cold, and you are not being hired to test whether the market exists.
What you will do
Build and manage a focused pipeline of qualified mining-technology opportunities
Open new relationships with mine executives, technical services, engineering, digital transformation, IT and procurement
Carry deals personally from first contact through discovery, proposal, negotiation and signature
Convert paid assessments and pilots into full deployments
Navigate vendor registration, cybersecurity review and enterprise procurement
Keep clean CRM records, forecasts and closing plans, and protect gross margin throughout

Desired Experience & Qualification

The three things that matter
You understand mining
. Not “I sold into mining once.” You know how a pit and a plant actually run, what a mine manager is measured on, why the maintenance superintendent and the production superintendent want different things, and what happens to a capital budget between March and June.
You have the network, and it is current.
You can get a meeting with people who make decisions, this quarter, because of who you already are — not because you filled in a vendor registration form and waited.
You are technically credible.
You can run a first conversation about integration, data, fleet systems and architecture on your own. You will have technical specialists behind you for depth, but you are not a relay station between the customer and the engineers.
Everything below is secondary to those three.
The rest of it
10+ years in enterprise, technical or consultative B2B sales
A track record of personally closing high-value, multi-stakeholder deals into mining, mineral processing or heavy industry
Background in one or more of: mining software, fleet management, mine planning, industrial automation, OT, telemetry, IoT, OEM systems or systems integration
Willingness to travel regularly in South Africa and into selected African markets
Why a serious closer would take this
Uncapped, with accelerators
. No ceiling on a strong year.
Six-month ramp guarantee.
Mining sales cycles are long. We know that. We are not asking you to fund ours out of your own pocket while you build a pipeline.
Every engagement is revenue.
We run paid assessments, not free proof-of-concepts. You are never given away for nothing to a mine that was never going to buy.
Real autonomy.
You shape how this market gets attacked — accounts, sequencing, approach. Not just execution of someone else’s plan.
Access.
Short chain to the people who decide. Ask a pricing question, get an answer the same week.
You are the hire.
Not one of nine reps in a region. The commercial outcome in this market will be visibly yours.
Who this is not for
Straight, so nobody wastes anybody’s time:
If you need a marketing engine to generate your leads, this is not it
If your last three years have been account management rather than hunting, this will be a hard adjustment
If you want a large-corporate safety net, we do not have one — what we have instead is upside and speed.

Package & Remuneration

Market-related fixed CTC, set against experience, network and closing record
Target variable of broadly equal weight. Uncapped, with accelerators above target
Commission vests on signature, paid on collection — you are credited when you close
Renewal commission from year two on everything you sign
Six-month ramp guarantee, non-recoverable against your commission. You will never work off a debt to us
Sign-on consideration where you are forfeiting accrued commission elsewhere
Approved travel and customer-engagement expenses
Real numbers at first interview, not at offer stage

descriptions.description:
Introduction

The company is a South African business optimisation and growth consultancy. We help small and medium enterprises replace fragmented, manual and people dependent ways of working with structured processes, connected systems and clear management visibility.
We work across three divisions. Marketing builds demand generation systems. Sales builds structured sales processes and outsourced sales capability. Operations builds workflow, automation and reporting systems. We implement rather than advise, and we support what we build.
Our primary focus is professional services firms, with accounting practices and construction as our core client segments. We are also commercialising software platforms for specific industries through joint ventures with sector partners.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Client Solutions Consultant is responsible for generating new recurring revenue by identifying businesses with operational or growth problems, diagnosing those problems credibly, and converting them into long term client relationships.
This is a consultative role rather than a transactional one. Our clients do not buy software. They buy a way out of administrative chaos, lost leads, owner dependence and poor visibility. The consultant must be able to hold a business conversation with a practice principal or business owner, understand how their business actually works, and articulate what a better operating model would look like before any product is mentioned.
Key responsibilities
New business development
Build and manage a pipeline of qualified opportunities within the target client segments.
Conduct structured discovery meetings with business owners, practice principals and decision makers.
Identify operational and commercial problems and translate them into a clear scope of work.
Prepare and present proposals, and negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters.
Close new recurring revenue against an agreed monthly target.
Client relationship management
Act as account owner for clients you introduce, including onboarding handover to the delivery team.
Conduct scheduled account reviews and identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts.
Manage renewals and maintain client retention within your book.
Platform and product sales
Sell Red Hot Zone services and, where assigned, industry software platforms commercialised through group joint ventures.
Support product launches, including early client recruitment and reference customer development.
Pipeline discipline and reporting
Maintain accurate and current records of all activity, opportunities and forecasts in the company CRM.
Report weekly on activity and pipeline, and participate in monthly and quarterly performance reviews.
Provide market feedback on client objections, competitor activity and product gaps.
Network development
Represent Red Hot Zone at referral network meetings, industry events and professional forums.
Develop referral relationships with advisers, associations and complementary service providers.
Hunt for new business using cold outreach tactics.

Desired Experience & Qualification

Essential
A minimum of three years of business to business sales experience with a demonstrable record of closing recurring revenue or retained service agreements.
Experience selling a considered, consultative product or service to business owners or senior decision makers.
The ability to understand how a business operates and to diagnose operational problems in conversation.
Strong written and verbal communication in English, and the ability to write a clear commercial proposal.
Disciplined pipeline management and comfort working to a monthly revenue target.
A valid driver licence and willingness to travel to client premises.
Computer literacy, including comfort with CRM systems and business software.
Advantageous
Experience selling into accounting practices, professional services firms or the SME advisory market.
Exposure to software as a service, business systems, workflow platforms or process consulting.
Existing professional network within the Mpumalanga and Lowveld business community.
Afrikaans in addition to English.
Experience of structured referral networks such as BNI.

descriptions.description:
Position: Senior Databricks Data Engineer
(Hybrid/Pinelands, Cape Town)
Confluent Services, South Africa’s largest and multi-award winning debt management company, has a position available for a Data Engineer.
This individual will join the Data Team and will be accountable for data engineering design, data ingestion and support across on-premise and cloud-based platforms.
What’s in it for you?
Being South Africa’s largest company of its kind, Confluent is continuously growing, with no signs of stopping. At Confluent, we build on current-generation platforms like Databricks and Microsoft Fabric, giving you hands-on exposure to tools and patterns that are shaping the future of data engineering. This is not a legacy maintenance role, you’ll be involved in designing, building, and evolving data solutions from the ground up, with real room for creativity and engineering judgement.
You’ll work alongside a team of high caliber senior data engineers, where knowledge sharing is part of how we operate. Technical discussions are encouraged, opinions are respected, and decisions are driven by merit rather than hierarchy. Our team is actively involved in AI and machine learning initiatives, giving you exposure beyond traditional data pipelines.
We value clean architecture, thoughtful design, and creativity. You will have the opportunity to influence how things are built, contribute to architectural decisions, and help shape the evolution of our data platform.
Culturally, we are a diverse, respectful, and collaborative team. We invest in people, support continuous learning, and create an environment where engineers can grow both technically and professionally. Whether you want to deepen your engineering expertise or broaden your impact across the business, you’ll find room to do so here.
Beyond the work itself, Confluent offers a stable, growing environment where the data you build helps real South Africans improve their financial outcomes, giving purpose and impact to the systems you design.
Other key benefits:
We have a vibrant office in a lively part of the city, meaning you have easy access to stores and outlets if you need.
We offer company benefits – medical aid, retirement annuity, Bursaries and Insurance
We have a culture of growth, meaning you have access to move both upwards or across in the business if you want to.
Requirements
Candidates must be able to demonstrate:
Minimum 3 years experience as a data engineer or in a similar role, designing and implementing data pipelines, data integration and ETL processes.
Practical experience in Azure, Azure Data Factory and Azure Databricks is preferred.
Proven experience in Python/PySpark and SQL/SparkSQL programming skills.
At least 3 years of experience in Information Technology – specifically in technical data roles e.g. data engineering, data analytics or data science.
Knowledge of data management and storage solutions, including SQL Server Database, Azure Data Lake Storage or similar.
Having good communication skills and being able to operate in a team environment.
Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills related to data, data structures and algorithms.
Key responsibilities will include:
Contribute to the architecture and design of the Confluent Data Platform and ingestion patterns.
Implement and support the scalable data solutions on the Microsoft Azure cloud platform, including Azure Databricks.
Develop, maintain and optimise robust production data pipelines for data ingestion, processing, and transformation to support analytics, machine learning and other downstream data-driven services.
Ensure data security, quality and integrity across all of the pipelines and related data processes.
Collaborate with the data product owner, analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and implement effective data workflows.
Assist in data initiatives and support technical teams including architects, analysts, software developers, and data scientists.
Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Certifications in Azure, Microsoft Fabric Data Engineering, Azure Databricks Data Engineering or similar or equivalent practical experience.
